Kozy Oaks Kamp is a family-owned, family-friendly campground offering activities for all ages. Kozy Oaks Kamp is conveniently located on Horse leg lake, a small non-motorized environmental lake, less than an hour's drive north from the Twin Cities on I-35. Due to the depth of the lake, it is not a great fishing lake but perfect for small non-motorized water craft, and there are many good fishing lakes in the area. Kozy Oaks is near Blaine sports center, Almelund, North Branch, Cambridge, Isanti, Lindstrom, Stacy, Taylors Falls and Forest Lake, Minnesota. The grounds are adjacent to hiking and biking trail access at Irving and John Anderson County Park. Come relax and enjoy our wooded sites, pool, game room, mini-golf all surrounded by large oaks and beautiful views.

Contact Us
Welcome to Lax Lake Resort
a family tradition since 1928
Nestled in a beautiful and scenic valley of northeast Minnesota’s Sawtooth Mountains is Lax Lake. Once a logging community and Northern Rail stop, it has been home to many intrigued by its beauty. It is here where each day nature’s ensemble invites your senses to experiences that no other place has. We welcome those who appreciate the peacefulness of God’s country and offer an enjoyable vacation doing what we we can to make your stay pleasurable and memorable...
LAX LAKE RESORT and CAMPGROUND... OUR STORY
Tucked just miles off of the super highway of the north shore (Highway 61) and the Big Lake of Superior, you will find Lax Lake. The Johannes Waxlax family laid claim to the area and settled it in 1894. By 1907, Lax Lake became a thriviing community that developed with the introduction of logging and the laying of the railway by the Alger-Smith Lumber Company's Duluth and Northern Rail Road. In time, Lax Lake had its own schoolhouse, newspaper and saloon. Although not for passengers, people could board the train at the present day resort to travel to surrounding areas. For a short span, Lax Lake was a town on the map with its own post office that operated until 1915. When the logging was done and the tracks removed, the "town" disappeared, but some of the established community remained. John Waxlax (son of Johannes) who previously farmed and operated a little general store, officially opened Lax Lake Resort in 1928 on the same site. John envinsioned a destination that offered both tenting and lodging with the construction of 8 lakeside cabins. Eventually John's son and wife took over the resort's operation. After 45 years in the John Waxlax family, in 1973 the resort was sold to the Rudloff family where it has now remained for 49 years.
When purchased by the Rudloff's, only four of the eight cabins (built around the early to mid 1930s) and the office building remained. At present, two of the cabins are rented, one is our boathouse, and one is slated to be restored. In 1979 we moved buildings from what was the old Candlelight Motel by Split Rock when the land was made a state refuge. The motel unit later took a facelift to become what is now our "duplex" unit. Outhouses gave way to the construction of our "lodge" building in 1990 and modern toilets, showers, laundry and sleeping (lodge rooms) were added. At one point the main office also served as a little restaurant and grocery stop. Weekly visits were made by Bill the Dairy Man and Tom the Candy Man, to name a couple of our special suppliers. We also a had a mini golf coarse. Throughout the years those items have been eliminated and are now added to the many chapters in the resort's history. Since it's beginning, however, the resort has held on to John's original vision of being a destination for camping and lodging in a special nook of the Sawtooth Mountains of Lake County, Minnesota.
Lax Lake Resort is "ma and pa" vintage style resort. It is not a fancy place... it's uniqueness and charm is that it's one of the few remaining family operated resorts still in operation in the arrowhead. It's not a big place... another added charm. The resort is close to the many wonders that the north shore has to offer, yet, with the increasing number of tourists to the area, a place to get away from the crowds. In the changing times of vacation stays, Lax Lake Resort is often stated by our guests to be a refreshing pause in time. You may not find great cell phone service due to the hills. There are no tvs in the rooms... Hey, you're supposed to be on vacation. We do not take on-line reservations as we like to meet our guests and let them meet us. We know that we are not a fit for everybody, and that's okay... better to find out before you head out. Quiet time means quiet time...(SORRY CHARLIE, not the place to party it up). Vacation is meant for decompression, and we hope our guests respect each other's vacation... wouldn't you rather listen to the soft lapping of waves rather than someone else's radio? Our place is catored to those who want an opportunity to slow things down a bit and create memories. Maybe it's the first fish your child caught or that chipmunk who ate your chips. Maybe it's finally getting in a canoe or holding an ice-cream cone in one hand and a fishing pole or book in the other while sitting on the dock. Maybe it's waking up to the call of the loons and watching the sun rise over the hills. Maybe it's hiking to one of the many near-by breath taking waterfalls and the stories later told about your day's adventures around your campfire. We are seasonal family resort operated by three generations who pool and trade their time to keep the legacy of sharing our place to those who appreciate it. Whether you use our place as a central location for your vacation outings, or you spend your entire time with us, we invite you to our little resort on the lake.
FURTHER OFFICE AMMENITIES
We have a little store of souviniers, cards, supplies, bait, firewood and basic camp foods. Our selection of clothing can outfit you in Lax Lake style. Wi-Fi is available by the office area and not throughout the grounds... but you don't have to tell your boss that.
The ice cream cone sign on our building invites all to our most popular tradition ... hand scooped ice cream featuring assorted flavors.

By completing this reservation, I agree to abide by all campground rules and the
Refund/Cancellation Policy.
PLEASE NOTE: All reservations are online only. There is no staff/office to check in
with once on premise. We ask that you keep your receipt in your vehicle window to
show proof of purchase for your stay. Parks Staff periodically check sites. In the event
of a double booking, please call the PRCE Office Mon-Fri 9:00-4:00 pm at
320.587.2975 or the non-emergency Police number after 4:00 pm and weekends:
320.587.2242.
CAMPGROUND RULES
• Check-in time: 2:00 PM and checkout time: 12:00 PM.
• No overnight camping on roadway.
• Long term camping is not permitted. Reservations are one full hook-up or electric only
campsite for up to 14 consecutive nights. Reservations for tent sites are available up to
3 consecutive nights.
• A parent or guardian must accompany persons under the age of 18.
• Place separated garbage in the appropriate receptacles or dumpster (next to the dump
station). Do not leave garbage in the restroom, fire ring, or at the site.

wheeled camping unit per site.
• Domestic pets are allowed but must be leashed and attended to at all times. Pets must
be kept inside the camping unit during overnight hours. No more than two pets per
campsite. Hutchinson city ordinances require pet owners to clean up their pet's waste
and dispose of properly.

• Quiet hours begin at 10:00 PM. Visitors must leave campground by 10:00 PM.
• Fireworks of any kind are not allowed within the park.

Camp and Fish on Leech Lake at New Leech Lake Campground & Resort
FIREWOOD RESTRICTIONS: Due to the emarald ash borer (EAB) a firewood restriction order has been issued by the DNR. Therefore, no firewood is to be brought into camp. All firewood must be purchased from us.
PROTECT LEECH LAKE FROM AIS: Remember to keep our lake safe and free of Aquatic Invasive Speies by emptying any water from your boat, live wells and bait buckets before entering our waters. Thank You.
New Leech Lake Campground is open year round for summer and winter ice fishing, hunting, snowmobiling and ATVing. We are located on Portage Bay at the north end of Leech Lake. We offer seasonal, primitive tenting, and full hookup campsites. We have two housekeeping apartments (like cabins) above our lodge that are set up to be used individually or with a door that opens to allow the two apartments to become one. These apartments are available for a daily and weekly rate. Leech Lake Campground is an affordable, friendly fishing camp and a great safe place for children to play outside in nature!
Leech Lake’s fantastic fishing is the main draw for our guests. Excellent fishing begins right off our docks. Leech Lake is well known among anglers for its excellent walleye, northern pike, and muskie fishing but the lake also boasts large numbers of perch, largemouth bass, smallmouth bass, black crappie and panfish.
If you are looking to take a couple steps back in time and escape the hustle and bustle of the world and go into the woods, back to nature (NOT TOO BACK TO NATURE THOUGH) to a small Mom & Pop style get away … then this is the place for you. We DO NOT have kareoke or a music playing, booming bar or a full service restaurant. We DO HAVE peace and quiet. Tranquility. Relaxation. We are a small camp where people are glad to see you and will give you tips on the hot fishing spots or what baits are doing well. We are not a party camp. You can stay up all night and enjoy your cocktails if you like to, you just have to have respect for what the next person in camp desires for their vacation are and keep the noise level down. We are secluded enough and small enough that we are a safe place for the kids to go out and play in the sand or dirt or ride bike or swim. They can look around canp and find bugs, turtles, flowers, leaves, etc. It really is the appreciation of nature in our camp.
Plan your trip
Local Radar
Detailed Forecast
New Leech Lake Campground has an easy access boat launch ramp and a harbor updated with a floating dock system. We ask that you provide your own boat ties and bumpers.
We have a beach area where the water level is very gradual and works well for little ones to play in.
Our LODGE has a pool table, restrooms, a 32″ color TV and an assortment of basic groceries and WIFI internet access.
We have very nice sized bundles of firewood for sale. They are delivered to your campsite fire ring.
We do not sell fishing licenses so be sure to get yours before you arrive.
We carry leeches and worms but do not have minnows on hand.

RV Park Rules and Regulations:
Check out time is noon. Email to be sure the site is not reserved and then add additional day(s) in pay box.
Changing of sites only with approval first.
Quiet time is 10:00 pm to 8:00 am.
One unit per site unless you are paying for double occupancy.

Please take your trash to the dumpster located in the park.
Pets are welcome if kept on a leash, quiet and supervised at all times. Owners must pick up after their pets.
Parents/guardians will be responsible for their children's conduct and safety while on property. Minors may not be left unattended in the RV Park.
We reserve the right to deny occupancy at any time for any reason deemed appropriate.
​
Owens Place RV Park is not responsible for loss due to fire, theft, utility failure, improper connections and failure to unhook water during freezing conditions or any acts of nature.
Please be aware of bear and raccoon in the area. Keep your food in an enclosed area. Emptying your trash often will help prevent unwanted visitors!
The dumpster is located near the midpoint of the park's driveway.
If you have any questions you may call 218-398-3219 and leave a message.
Fee Procedure:
Daily Fee
Single Occupancy $35.00
Single Occupancy
is defined as a group of eight people or less with up to two motorized vehicles. A family of more than eight people is considered a single occupancy if there are no more than two adults with the immediate children.
Double Occupancy $70.00
Double Occupancy
is defined as two groups with no more than two vehicles, camping together.
Single Occupancy = One of the following
Trailer- includes pop-up campers, Pickup Campers, Motor Home-includes RV's and buses
Double Occupancy = Two of the above
​
How To Pay:
Complete the fee envelope information. Put required fee in a single envelope for single occupancy and put required fee into two envelopes for double occupancy (payment may be made for one or more consecutive days).
Payment may be made by check issued to (Owens Place RV Park) or with cash.
Verify fee envelope information; tear off stub and put envelope in
deposit vault located by reader board.
Display stub on windshield.
Permit valid for this site only for the day(s) paid.
Firewood Regulations:
You Can Have:
Firewood you collect from dead and down trees within the RV Park.
Non-ash firewood from within 100 miles of the Chippewa National Forest. If you bought it, it
must be from a vendor certified by the MN DNR.
Kiln-dried lumber that is not painted or stained. (No pallet boards)!
Kiln, heat treated firewood from MN certified by the MN Department of Agriculture, must include
sticker.

Welcome to Peaceful Valley Campground
If you've been searching for a quiet, peaceful, out in the woods place for your next camping trip; or simply need a quiet place for an overnight stay, you've come to the right place. Nestled in a valley near the Minnesota River, Peaceful Valley Campground is just down the road but feels like miles away from your everyday life. There's lots to do in the area or you can put your feet up and relax.
View a map of our campground.
Check out the Area Attractions.
Find our campground or contact us.
We have small store in case you forgot something. There is a camp library if you need a book to read or a game for a rainy day. Do you need to store your camper for the winter? We can help. Check out the Area Attractions page to see what there is to do in the area. We're close to the Twin Cities Metro area so you can enjoy all the city has to offer. There is a playground and lots of space for the kids to play. All of our sites have a picnic table and fire ring (we have wood available). You can choose between water and electric sites or full hook-ups. There is a sanitary dump station on site for your use as you leave. Come stay for a weekend, a month or for the whole season.
Peaceful Valley is a family owned campground and we're here to make sure you have an enjoyable time. Visit the attractions in the area or just sit back and listen to the birds. Come join us for your next camping getaway.

Compost Site
Compost Site
City of Madelia
The c
ompost site is located on Joy Ave SW adjacent to the Madelia Golf Course.
The Madelia Compost site is only available for use to residents or business owners within our community only. Person(s) living outside of City limits are prohibited from using the site.
The only materials that are accepted at the compost are: trees, tree trimmings, brush, leaves, garden plants and grass clippings.
ALL OTHER MATERIAL(including garbage, lumber, concrete, cement, cardboard, windows, doors, tires, batteries, steel, and furniture) are prohibited. Violators will be fined. This is NOT a landfill.
The compost generally opens in the early Spring, weather dependent and closes for the season late fall, weather dependent.
Seasonal Hours:
We have installed security cameras at the compost site so we can better monitor what is coming in and leaving the compost. Therefore, the compost should be open most everyday until it closes for the season, weather pending.
If there is a fair amount of precipitation and the grounds are too soft, we will lock the gate until the grounds dry up enough for vehicles to drive through without creating ruts.
If the compost site is abused (violators will be fined), we will have to go back to the scheduled days and times we’ve had in the past. If that should happen. No one will be able to enter the compost unless they are a key holder and/or have visited City Hall to complete the temporary day pass application and have paid the fee.
If you are in need of access to the compost on it’s closed days (no weekends), you are an in town Madelia resident, and/or a contractor working in town, you have the option to obtain a key for temporary daily access by completing a temporary access form and paying the $25.00 fee. Please contact City Hall for more information. 507.642.3245

DeLagoon Park Upgrades
DeLagoon Park Upgrades
DeLagoon Park Construction Updates
June 10, 2025- Improvements are still moving forward, with pavement areas affected by utility work being patched on 6/09 and 6/10.
April 14, 2025- Throughout the winter months crews were able to work on some miscellaneous tasks as weather permitted and the shower building is now set in place. Construction activities will begin ramping up as spring arrives. Over the next few weeks, crews will be working on the campsites, finish installing utilities followed by paving and final seeding throughout the campground.
Although crews will be working around sports complexes, all fields and parking lots will remain open during all events. Please be patient with crews during these times as they do their best to finish work and maintain the parking areas.
August 9, 2024 - Comstock Construction was awarded the campground improvement project on May 6. The campground will have 42 RV sites (10 with sewer, water, electric and 32 with water and electric). There will be 8 tent sites, a shower/bath house and RV dump station. The asphalt paving and final turf installation won't happen until 2025. It is anticipated the campground will be ready to use in July 2025.
Lighting improvements at the softball complex are complete and have been functioning throughout the summer. The materials for the baseball field lighting are being procured and the project will be completed prior to the 2025 spring baseball season.
images
DeLagoon Park
A popular regional destination for camping, disc golf, baseball, softball, soccer, and BMX racing, DeLagoon Park has not undergone a significant improvement project in many years. A 2015 master plan laid out ideal changes that City Council saw fit to revise and fit into a sales tax proposal:
Campground upgrades, including utility hookups, toilets/ showers, a dump station, and ability for online reservations.
Restroom and concession facilities for soccer and softball users
Restroom and lighting upgrades for baseball and softball users
Park upgrades= $5.2 Mil
The additional cost to operate the DeLagoon Park campground would be $18,575. This includes general maintenance, water and sewer costs and costs for the reservation system. There will also be new electric costs. All operations will be offset by revenue from campground reservations. The operating costs would be added to the City’s annual budget and included in the property tax levy.

About the Campground
DeLagoon Campground offers a variety of sites to suit your camping needs:
9 tent sites
32 RV sites with partial hook-ups (water & electric)
10 RV sites with full hook-ups (water, sewer & electric)
Off-season camping is October 1-November 1.

Online Reservation System: www.campspot.com/book/DeLagoon-Campground

Refund/ Cancellation Policy
We understand there may be unexpected changes or adjustments needed to your reservation. Camping is an outdoor experience and there are no refunds due to inclement weather.
Campground Rules
Campsites reservations are available by on-line registration only . We have a 7-night maximum.
Each site must be kept clean of trash, clutter and animal waste.
Check-in time is 2 pm / Check-out time is 12 pm
Quiet hours are 10 pm – 8 am .
Children must always be supervised.
Two vehicles per campsite.
No smoking.
Profanity or violence towards other guests or management is grounds for immediate eviction. Language and conduct should always be suitable for all ages.
The use of firearms, archery, paintball, slingshots, or air guns is prohibited.
Fireworks of any kind are prohibited.
No ATV’s, minibikes, or scooters may be ridden in the park/campground.
Fires & Firewood
Fires are only allowed in the fire rings that are provided.
You may bring your own firewood.
No chopping of trees or burning of garbage.
Bathroom/shower rules:
No smoking in bathrooms or shower area
No flushing of feminine products
No using sinks for washing dishes
Pet rules:
Dogs must always be kept on a 6-foot leash
Dogs cannot be tied up outside and unattended
You are responsible for picking up after your pet
Loud or excessive barking will not be tolerated
The City of Fergus Falls is not responsible for accidents.
An emergency response plan for the campground is available here .
Contact
For questions about the DeLagoon Campground, please contact Parks and Recreation at 218-332-5806 or email delagooncampground@fergusfallsmn.gov .

We are thankful to the citizens of Fergus Falls for voting and passing the city sales tax in November 2022 to allow major renovations of the DeLagoon Campground and Softball Complex area.

About the Steel Wheel
Family owned and operated, The Steel Wheel Campground and Trading Post is in the heart of the Black Hills. Our welcoming 12‑acre retreat is nestled just six miles south of historic Deadwood, SD, along US‑385. Situated at approximately 5,300 feet elevation, our clean, well-maintained grounds feature a variety of accommodations, including modern cabin rentals , park‑model cabins , full‑hookup RV sites , and a 12-person lodge rental .
Our guests enjoy amenities including hot showers, clean restrooms, laundry facilities, and a dump station. At the heart of it all, our Trading Post offers fuel, supplies, deli fare, and seasonal daily specials from Memorial Day through Labor Day.
About Us
Steel Wheel Campground Features
Campsites with Hookups
All RV camping spots offer 30/50 amp hookups.
WiFi + Cellular Service
In addition to cellular service, Steel Wheel offers reliable WiFi.
Onsite Gas Station
Fill up on cheaper gas prices before getting into town at the Steel Wheel.
Easy Access to Trails
From hiking and biking to ATV and OTV trails, we have you covered.
BBQ Grill with Picnic Tables
Relax under picnic tables or enjoy one of our multiple fire pits.
Food Court
Ready for a hot meal? Drop into the Steel Wheel for Hot 'n' ready food.

FAQ's
Where is Steel Wheel Campground located and what are nearby attractions?
Steel Wheel Campground & Cabins is located on US Hwy 385, just 6 miles south of historic Deadwood, South Dakota. We’re centrally located in the Black Hills, near major landmarks like Mount Rushmore, Crazy Horse Memorial, and numerous ATV/snowmobile trails, lakes, and hiking paths.
What types of camping and lodging options are available?
We offer a variety of accommodations including full hookup RV sites (30/50 amp), electric-only RV sites, camping cabins , and park model cabins . Please note that pets are welcome at campsites but not allowed inside cabins.
Do you offer food and drink options on site?
Yes! From Memorial Day through Labor Day, our deli and food court serve a variety of meals, beverages, and daily specials—perfect for guests who prefer to dine on-site.
Can I rent a UTV or get trail access directly from the campground?
Absolutely. UTV and Roxor rentals are available on-site through Mad Peak Rentals. Trail passes can be purchased at the Trading Post, and road permits for ATVs are available through the Lawrence County Treasurer’s office.
What are the internet and cell service options at the campground?
We offer 3 Mbps wireless internet to all guests. AT&T 4G coverage is reliable, and we provide a Verizon booster near the camp store to improve connectivity for other carriers.
Are pets allowed at the campground?
Yes, pets are welcome at campsites as long as they are leashed and never left unattended outside. However, pets are not allowed in cabins. Please clean up after your pet—failure to follow the policy may result in removal from the campground.

Regular Rates, Reservations, & Cancellation
Reservations must be made with a credit card. A confirmation letter will be sent to the Reserving Party detailing the guaranteed reservation information. A minimum deposit of one-night's stay will be charged to your card to hold your reservation. You may cancel your reservation up to 3 days prior to your stay for a cancellation fee equal to the cost of one-night's stay. Cancellation notices must be submitted via phone. If a cancellation notice is received less than three (3) days in advance of reserved date, then the total reserved nights will be charged to the credit card. Site Rates per night do not include tax. Upon arrival and check in at the campground the remaining balance will be charged to your card. If making reservations for others, the party making the reservations is responsible for all the sites and extra person charges, and will be charged the total amount.

Regular Rates, Reservations, & Cancellation
Reservations must be made with a credit card. A confirmation letter will be sent to the Reserving Party detailing the guaranteed reservation information. A minimum deposit of one-night's stay will be charged to your card to hold your reservation. You may cancel your reservation up to 3 days prior to your stay for a cancellation fee equal to the cost of one-night's stay. Cancellation notices must be submitted via phone. If a cancellation notice is received less than three (3) days in advance of reserved date, then the total reserved nights will be charged to the credit card. Site Rates per night do not include tax. Where is Steel Wheel Campground located and what are nearby attractions?
Steel Wheel Campground & Cabins is located on US Hwy 385, just 6 miles south of historic Deadwood, South Dakota. We’re centrally located in the Black Hills, near major landmarks like Mount Rushmore, Crazy Horse Memorial, and numerous ATV/snowmobile trails, lakes, and hiking paths.
What types of camping and lodging options are available?
We offer a variety of accommodations including full hookup RV sites (30/50 amp), electric-only RV sites, camping cabins , and park model cabins . Please note that pets are welcome at campsites but not allowed inside cabins.
Do you offer food and drink options on site?
Yes! From Memorial Day through Labor Day, our deli and food court serve a variety of meals, beverages, and daily specials—perfect for guests who prefer to dine on-site.
Can I rent a UTV or get trail access directly from the campground?
Absolutely. UTV and Roxor rentals are available on-site through Mad Peak Rentals. Trail passes can be purchased at the Trading Post, and road permits for ATVs are available through the Lawrence County Treasurer’s office.
What are the internet and cell service options at the campground?
We offer 3 Mbps wireless internet to all guests. AT&T 4G coverage is reliable, and we provide a Verizon booster near the camp store to improve connectivity for other carriers.
Are pets allowed at the campground?
Yes, pets are welcome at campsites as long as they are leashed and never left unattended outside. However, pets are not allowed in cabins. Please clean up after your pet—failure to follow the policy may result in removal from the campground.

Recreation Mission, Programs & Services
Creating Community Through People, Parks & Programs
Goals
The recreational programming goals of the Brookings Park, Recreation and Forestry Department include:
Establishing an atmosphere at each sponsored activity, which is supportive of the efforts of each participant and affirms their worth
Providing enjoyable recreational activities, which enhance the quality of life for participants and volunteer leaders
Providing recreational opportunities, both competitive and non-competitive, for persons of all ages at a reasonable expense
In order for these goals to be met it is expected that leaders, volunteers and paid staff, do the following:
Attempt to include every participant in every activity.
Give positive reinforcement to each participant.
Provide educational feedback in a calm manner.
Public Recreation
The Recreation Department provides a wide range of youth and adult public recreational activities. City Recreation exists to provide opportunities for leisure time activities at an affordable cost, usually subsidized by public funds, which are not feasible or easily provided by the private sector. Programs have developed primarily through a process of request and interest.
Long-Term Benefits
Learning of life skills in recreation activities.
Providing a well-rounded list of recreational opportunities to meet expectations of current residents and as an attraction to those considering relocating to Brookings.
All residents are served to the degree that they choose or are able to participate. However, in general, it could be fairly stated that city recreation in Brookings, especially as concerns the expenditures of tax dollars, puts a high priority on youth, providing numerous activities for their leisure time.
Activities
Specific activities include but not limited to:
Youth: baseball / softball, recreational swimming, tennis, golf, basketball, ice skating, field trips, horsemanship, fishing, etc., open gyms, youth soccer, ice activities
Adult: baseball / softball, swimming, golf, tennis, basketball, volleyball, ice skating, open gyms, etc.

Parks Missions, Programs & Services
Purpose
The purpose of the Park Section of Parks, Recreation and Forestry is to provide parcels of open-space, green areas throughout the city, for aesthetic purposes, as sites for recreation activities and to reduce the perceived and real population density of residential areas.
The Parks Department builds and maintains the parks in the Brookings Park system, comprising over 640 acres. Included are:
Baseball / football complex
Community parks
Indoor ice arena
Municipal golf course
Neighborhood parks and playgrounds
Six-mile bike / recreational trail
Softball complex
Maintenance
The department also cooperates closely with the Brookings School District in building and maintaining joint school / park facilities.
The Parks Department maintains a fully equipped maintenance fleet of vehicles, mowers and specialty equipment. A full-time staff assisted by seasonal employees provides all maintenance and plays a significant role in developing and constructing new parks.
Open Space
A long-term benefit of the park system is an assurance that open space and parks will be available in the future in developed neighborhoods. The activities in these parks may change over the years, but once the land is plotted and developed, it is unlikely that it can be converted back to open space.

Our campsites feature scenic views, and plenty of space for your crew. Whether you’re here to fish, game, or relax around a campfire, our campground is the perfect place to make memories.

A convenience store stocked with gas, fishing and hunting licenses, bait, tackle, and everything you need for a successful day outdoors

Campground-Reservations
Contact Us
We have 15 RV campsite pads. There are both back-in & pull-thru sites available. Prairie Pasque Campground offers full hook-ups including: electricity, sewer, city water, garbage service. Nice level lots. Easy access to all amenities as we are the most convenient campground in Watertown, SD. We do not have any shower facilities.
As you can see in the above picture, we do not have much for shade trees and we are not next to a nice lake; but we are very convenient and we do our best to make your stay a pleasant one! :) You may call anytime with questions.
We usually open around April 1st and close about the middle of November. Being in South Dakota, we have learned to be flexible as the weather can be unpredictable.
Directions
RV Campground
1.75 miles West of I-29 (Exit 177) on U.S. Hwy. 212. Turn South on 17th St. South, which is right before Watertown Chrylser store. You will go 1/2 mile South and then turn East onto 16th Avenue SE.
Our mailing address says 14th Ave., but the campground is actually on 16th Ave.

Prairie Pasque Campground is close to major roadways I-29 and U.S. Hwy. 212

Larive Lake Resort is located in the Southern Black Hills in Hot Springs, South Dakota. 7 Clans Casino, Resort and RV Park reserves the right to assign spaces to any and all guests entering the RV Park.
NO Tents Allowed

Garbage must be placed in dumpsters.
ABSOLUTELY NO OPEN FIRES ALLOWED.
Check-out time is noon. Vehicles that remain in the RV Park after this time will be charged an additional night’s rental fee.
Unruly or boisterous behavior will not be tolerated and is grounds for immediate ejection from the RV Park with NO REFUNDS.
NO UTV’s, Scooters, 4 Wheelers allowed on grounds.
The washing of automobiles or RVs is not allowed.
Children must stay within their space and are not allowed to play with electrical boxes, water faucets, or sewers.
The 5 MPH speed limit must always be observed.
Children under 13 must always be accompanied by an adult of 18 years or older

NO Window AC Units allowed.

We reserve the right to ensure your RV/Camper is in good repair and has soothing aesthetics, no broken windows, mirrors, or missing parts. RV/Camper shall have no fluid leaks of any kind.
Maintenance or Repairs on any vehicle is prohibited on grounds.
NO glass containers outside of RV/Camper.
Violations may result in fines or evictions with NO REFUNDS.
Quiet Hours 10:00 PM – 8:00 AM.
NO outside storage or clotheslines.
RV Park General Rules & Regulations

ABSOLUTELY NO FREE ROAMING PETS – All pets must be on a leash or in pens and cannot be tied up unless the owner is visibly present.
Owners are responsible for cleaning up after their pets.
For the safety and enjoyment of all our guests, pets must be well-mannered and non­-barking.
The pet walk and potty area to the North of Park Includes Pet cleanup bags and waste containers.
Please ensure pets do not relieve themselves on artificial turf or concrete grounds
Pet limit 3 per paid site. Pet weight is limited to 75Ibs and under for each pet.

Contact Us
Welcome to Horseshoe acres RV/mobile home park Llc, where comfort meets the great outdoors. Our owner-operated RV park provides clean facilities, friendly service, and flexible availability. Since we no longer support online reservations, please call or text us directly to reserve your spot. Your outdoor getaway awaits!
Show More
Explore Horseshoe acres RV/mobile home park Today!
Easy access
Easy access from I-35 take exit 40 then take Hwy 53 East 1.9 miles we are on the north side of Hwy.53.
We are just about half way between Dallas and Oklahoma City.
Whether you need a short stop or an extended stay, Horseshoe acres RV/mobile home park Llc offers flexible options to suit your needs. Our amenities ensure a comfortable experience with reliable Wi-Fi and full hookups. Make Horseshoe acres RV/mobile home park Llc your home away from home.
Comfortable RV Sites
At Horseshoe acres RV/mobile home park Llc, we offer comfortable and spacious RV sites designed for your convenience. Our full hookups, including Wi-Fi, ensure a seamless stay whether you're here for a night or long-term. Enjoy the tranquility and scenic views that make your visit memorable.
Nestled halfway between Dallas and Oklahoma City, our park offers an ideal stopover point. Easy access from I-35 allows for quick arrivals and departures. Experience the convenience of a well-situated RV park on your journey.
We offer
All full hookup-Back in and pull thru sites some 100 Ft long
2 Full bathrooms with walk in showers for guests use.
4 Washers ($2.00) and 4 dryers ($2.00)
Picnic Table at every site
Security Cameras around the park
Water hoses, sewer hoses and some parts available in small store in our office.
2 Ponds
Play set with sand!!
Basketball goal
72 Acres of area wooded and cleared to explore
Quiet clean safe park to the best of our ability
We have sheep and chickens in an enclosed area if you like to watch animals!! Also, fresh eggs on site
What we don't allow
Drama
Aggressive breed dogs for the safety of our park.
The dog limit is not something we wanted to do but after a few near incidents they are a must.
Open area to walk dogs or kids!!
Our Rates
Daily $40.00
Weekly $175.00
Monthly $500.00 includes $150 electric. Based on
2 Adults and 2 children extra $25.00 per person per month
WE accept cash, cards or moneyorders

pages.title: BC Ranch RV Park in Alpine, Texas
pages.text:
BC Ranch RV Park in Alpine, Texas
Welcome to BC Ranch RV Park
and the "Texas hospitality" town
of Alpine, Texas
Click
here for Alpine, Texas, forecast
Located just a couple of miles north of Alpine, the BC Ranch RV
Park is home to spectacular panoramic mountain views. Use our menu
at left for more information about our Facilities ,
Rates , and other information.
In the heart of the beautiful mountains of West Texas, Alpine is
the gateway for Big Bend National Park, Big Bend Ranch State Park,
and the Davis Mountains. Nearby is the Ft. Davis National Historic
Site, the McDonald Observatory, the Marfa Mystery Lights (seen on
the TV show Unsolved Mysteries ), the Chinati Foundation,
and spectacular wildlife viewing! Alpine is also the home of Sul
Ross State University, location of the Museum of Big Bend.
The climate is mild year-round and a perfect place
to visit all year long. Summer has low humidity with light breezes
and cool nights. Winter is also mild with lots of sunshine!
Come see for yourself the beauty and the wonder of the place called
the Last Frontier!

OVERVIEW
Comfortable Camping near Austin and Lake Bastrop
at our Hill Country Campground in Elgin Texas.
For reservations or further information call (512)-581-8033
Sunny skies, serene lakes, green forests, and the nearby attractions of Austin all combine to make Buena Vista RV Park in Elgin Texas into a camper's paradise. Join us at our RV park near Austin and enjoy the amenities! We're open year round, so you can stay with us through the winter and experience excellent activities like golfing, fishing, boating, hiking, gaming, and more.
Buena Vista RV Park , is located near Austin, and is conveniently set off Highway 290, about twenty-five minutes east of Interstate 35. The Austin/Bergstrum Airport is located just fourty five miles away. We're set in a gorgeous region of Texas Hill Country, not far from Lake Bastrop, Bastrop , and the Colorado River. Make our Elgin campground into your home base while you set out on day trips to explore the lakes and woods of our scenic area.
You can go boating and fishing at Lake Bastrop or the McKinney Roughs Nature Park , then do some hiking and, (if you have a horse to bring), go horseback riding through the wooded Lost Pines or take a walking tour of the Austin State Capitol. And for a taste of history, be sure to take in the Bastrop Opera House , the Elgin Depot Museum, and the Bastrop County Museum .
Elgin is known as the Sausage Capitol of Texas, so be sure to bring your taste buds when you visit during the Elgin Sausage Stampede in mid October or the Annual Hogeye Festival in late October. Join us for the Juneteenth Festival in mid June or the fun at the Western Days Festival, Parade, and Rodeo. With so much to do and see, we know you're going to enjoy your stay at our campground near Austin and Lake Bastrop. Join us today and see what camping in Texas Hill Country is all about!
We do not take credit cards .... only cash, checks, money orders, or cashier's checks.

The Best RV Experience in Central Texas
Nestled in the heart of Killeen, Texas just minutes from Fort Hood United States Army base, you will find a fully gated RV community with 175 sites offering full hook-ups, and accommodating rigs up to 50ft for both long and short term stays. All guests can have peace of mind knowing that only fellow RVers have access to the gate and secured laundry room.
Long term guests can take advantage of having their own locked mail box with mailing address, as well as having the option to rent storage sheds and staircases. If your an outdoorsy person or have dogs, you'll love the private gated entrance to the adjacent city park which boosts a 2 1/2 mile hike and bike trail. Finally, all residents benefit from a full-time onsite staff, with available help offered 7 days a week.

Reservations
MONTHLY RESERVATIONS
Reservations can be made up to 2 months prior to your arrival date. A deposit of $100 is due at time of reservation. The reservation deposit will be used as your electric deposit upon checking in. The first months lot rent will be due upon check in. Other deposits will include $10 optional mail box key. There is a $10 one time activation fee for the gate app.
DAILY/WEEKLY RESERVATIONS
Reservations can be made up to 2 months prior to arrival date. A reservation deposit of $40 for daily and $50 for weekly will be required. The deposit will be applied to the balance upon arrival. For stays during the following holidays; New Years, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas, a full payment will be required.
Refunds on Reservation Deposits
A 50% refund on the reservation deposit will be given if we are notified by phone during business hours 4 days prior to the check in date. NO REFUND will be given after the close of business 4 days prior to check in.
REFUNDS ON RESERVATION DURING HOLIDAYS
A refund of 50% will be given if we are notified by phone during business hours 2 weeks prior to the check in date. NO REFUND will be given after the close of business 2 weeks prior to check in.
Please call our office during business hours if you have any questions or to make reservations.

POLICIES
The Owner/Management assumes no responsibility for accidents, injuries or losses from any cause. Management reserves the right to evict any objectionable guest, visitor or trespasser.
All rents, electricity and any other fees must be paid on due date. if not paid within 3 days, then a

Coastal Oaks RV Resort reserves the right to assign all spaces.
Absolutely
NO PARKING ON THE GRASS
.
CHILDREN - Must be supervised at all times.
QUIET TIME -
10:00 PM to 8:00 AM
TRASH - Trash must be put out by the curb after 6:00 AM, but no later than 9:00 AM for pickup. Dumpster is by the road and trash may be placed in the container at any time.
PLEASE NO FISH, SHRIMP, CRAB, OR OYSTER SHELLS IN THE DUMPSTER
.
PETS - All pets must be on a leash at all times. Please pick up after your pet immediately. No pets allowed inside buildings or in pool area.
SPEED LIMIT - 5 MPH within the park area.
RESTROOMS - Open 24 Hours a day, except for cleaning.
SWIMMING POOL - Swimming hours are from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM. No pets in the pool area. No glass or breakable containers in the pool area. No Diving. Do not jump from the Spa ledge. No running or horseplay. Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult. Not responsible for accidents.
CLUBHOUSE - OPEN 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Resort guests only. No smoking in building. Group meetings may be arranged through management.
WATER - Nor rig washing without owner/management consent. There will be a charge. All professional companies must check in with management to pay washing fee. Washing of vehicles and boats are not allowed.
SEWER - Texas Law requires that a sewer hose must be fastened using a threaded connector or a rubber donut.
CLOTHESLINES - Permitted if they are attached to rear of your camper, are not unsightly and do not interfere with other guests.
VISITORS - Must be accompanied by registrants at all times. There is a charge for additional guests.
We appreciate you choosing to stay at our Park.
We ask that you read and abide by the rules so that everyone can have a safe and enjoyable stay.
Thank you for your cooperation.

Get Outside
The Great Outdoors
Experience the great outdoors and a great sense of community when you visit the Ray Roberts Lake State Park with your Denton rental motorhome. The park is named for the 29,000-acre Ray Roberts Lake, which offers swimming beaches, two marinas, and a fishing pier with a fish cleaning station. Boats, motors, jet skis, and kayaks are available for rent. There is an extensive trail system with an interactive trail map. Other recreational activities include hiking, biking, horseback riding, rollerblading, geocaching, nature viewing and photography, and much more.You can also visit the Lewisville Lake Environmental Learning Area and Nature Preserve when you camp in an RV near Denton. The area features multiple habitats such as prairies, forests, gardens, and aquatics. The visitor center is open on weekends and offers information, restrooms, and water and coffee. The 1869 log house is restored and furnished with period pieces. Recreational opportunities here include hiking, canoeing and kayaking, fishing, geocaching, and picnicking. Nature-related activities and programs are held regularly.The Fort Worth Nature Center and Refuge is also well worth a visit when you are RV camping at Destiny RV Resort. The center recreates the area as it was in the early 20th century and features forests, prairies, and wetlands. It was recognized with the Lone Star Land Steward award by the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department. The Hardwicke Interpretive Center features exhibits, information, and programs. There is an extensive trail system with a downloadable map. Guided and self-guided tours are available.

Lewisville Lake
Recreational opportunities here include hiking, canoeing and kayaking, fishing, geocaching, and picnicking. Nature-related activities and programs are held regularly.
Hiking
It was recognized with the Lone Star Land Steward award by the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department. The Hardwicke Interpretive Center features exhibits, information, and programs. There is an extensive trail system with a downloadable map. Guided and self-guided tours are available.

Enjoy Texas-style hospitality at Destiny's Dallas Resort. Beautifully wooded and just minutes from Dallas, Destiny provides a perfect setting to experience the lone Star State.

Welcome Home to the Ranch!
East View RV Ranch was built by RVers for RVers. We have a clean and quiet country living atmosphere, sitting atop of a hill with great views. We have some covered sites to help escape from the summer Texas heat.
Our Rec Room contains an area to relax and watch TV, a restroom with a full shower, and our laundry facilities with 4 commercial high speed washers and dryers.
Our Internet access is the best you'll find in an RV park. We have full coverage free access for most basic needs, but also have the capability to upgrade your service and speeds through dedicated access by either hardwired or wireless equipment.
Convenient to Central Texas Area Cities & Attractions​
We are located in Gerogetown, Texas, where the area is always changing and expanding. East View RV Ranch is within 40 minutes of Austin, with easy access to the 130 Toll Road and the I-35 corridor. Georgetown, Hutto, Pflugerville, Round Rock, and Sun City are only 10 to 20 minutes away.
Our park is a top choice to stay when coming to the area for youth sporting events and when visiting Southwestern University.
Several attractions, like Dell Diamond, Inner Space Caverns, the Blue Hole, and Typhoon Texas Water Park are all within minutes from the park, and less than 40 minutes from the Circuit of America's F1 track.

Camping in the Gulf Coast at our peaceful RV park in Victoria, Texas!
Palm trees, sandy beaches, and days filled with sunshine are just a part of what
makes the Texas Gulf Coast region so very special. Join us at
Gateway to the Gulf
RV park in Victoria , Texas, the perfect location
for your RV getaway. Whether you're a family, couple, retiree, or Winter Texan,
you can enjoy great camping
activities
like bass fishing at the Coleto Creek Reservoir or building
sand castles at
Port Aransas
. You'll find excellent facilities and fabulous nearby attractions at our Gulf Coast
campground. You won't want to miss it!
Plan your visit today with our easy-to-use online reservations system.
Gateway to the Gulf
is set between Houston, San Antonio, and Corpus Christi,
allowing guests the convenience of big city amenities and attractions. We're near
a number of highways, such as Highway 59, Highway 87, and Highway 77, so it's easy
to get to and from our Victoria RV park. We have excellent amenities right in camp
with our swimming pool, where you can start your day with a refreshing swim, our
Gazing Pond, and our 23 acres of well-groomed terrain.
When you're staying in the Victoria area, Gateway to the Gulf RV Park is your ideal
home base. Camp with us while you enjoy boating at Lake Texana State Park
or a tour of the historical site at the
Fannin Battleground State Historical
Park
. Our region features 600 miles of shoreline, white sandy beaches, and
a median temperature of 80 degrees. In other words, it's practically perfect! You
can enjoy gift shopping in
Port Lavaca
, hikes and boating at Matagorda Island ,
or a trip to see the animals at the Texas Zoo .
Away from the water, visitors will find that Victoria, Texas is a cultural and historic
hub for the area. Take a tour of the antique malls, art galleries, and specialty
shops, or head into Victoria for a delicious meal. Points of interest include historic
buildings and homes, the Museum of the Coastal Bend, the paintings at the Nave Museum , and a riverside
park and garden by the Guadalupe River. Victoria is also home to numerous festivals
and special events like art and craft shows, talent competitions, and seasonal celebrations.
There's just so much to do and see near Victoria, Texas!

off the ground.

balance not paid in full within one (1) day of due date will be assessed a late
charege of $5 per day, from due date, until paid in full.
$35.00 fee for returned checks. We maintain a No Refund policy.
Management reserves right to dispose of personal property abandoned at park

including reasonable attorney's fees, arising from any and all damages or injuries
caused by fire, water, wind, civil strife, acts of God, Owner/Operator and/or Customer
actions or inactions(or those of their employees, agents or invitees), or any other
related to Customer's use of occupation of the RV site, regardless of whether such
loss was caused by the negligence of any of the Compground parties.
THEFT OF SERVICE LAW: TEXAS PENAL CODE SECTION 31:04 (b), any guest who leaves without
paying for site services or who refuses to pay for site services when due is subjected
to criminal prosecution. We are providing service hook-ups for your RV. We require
full payment in advance and will prosecute any violations under the "THEFT OF SERVICE
LAW".
In order to maintain the Park appearance we ask everyone please follow these simple
Parking Guidelines
Pull-thru sites -
Vehicles must be parked in single file, directly in-line with RV on the
hard pack or concrete. Do not park two vehicles
side-by-side. Absolutely no parking on grass areas. Vehicles should be several
feet off road to allow large coaches and trailers ample room for parking and pulling
out. Do not park parallel to road at any time.
Do not park in unoccupied sites.
Back-in sites -
Vehicles must be parked side by side in front of RV. Do not pull vehicles
bryond electric pedestals or up between RVs onto grass area. Vehicles should be
several feet off road to allow large coaches and trailers ample room for parking
and pulling out Do not park parallel to road
at any time. Do not park in unoccupied sites.
Each site is allowed two vehicles provided parking guidelines can be followed. When
both vehicles will not properly fit at the site, additional parking is available
at the front and rear of the park along with parking for your visitors.
You are responsible to see that visitors at your site park properly.

About Us
Amenities
We invite you to explore one of the most unique resort properties in the Texas Hill Country. We offer RV sites for pull campers, 5th wheels, Motorhomes and tent camping. We also have cabins and shelters available if you just need a place to lay your head. Our amenities include, River access (Medina River), Dog Park, A large Event Center, Kitchen, Dining Room, Rec Center with work out equipment and many games to play, (Pool Tables, Foosball tables, ping pong, air hockey) a Texas shaped swimming pool, with a separate child pool, Nature trails, Bar-B-Que pit a Laundry Room, common shower facilities. Free WiFi.
Who we are
Our Event Center is one of the largest centers in the Texas Hill Country. It is great for Country Weddings, Family Reunions, Business Retreats or day meetings for a large group. With our ability to offer overnight facilities in our cabins, RV sites and shelters. It is the perfect place to stay for a weekend or a week or two. Our laid back attitude and friendly staff make this a great place to make memories for the entire family
Who We Accommodate
We work with all our guests to create a pleasant and worry free stay. We host Rallies for Motorcycle groups, church groups and people who need a home base to have day trips in the Hill Country. Affordable Country Weddings, and people who desire to have a recreational experience on the Medina River. Everyone from Full Time Campers, to Winter Texans to weekend family camping are welcome at our resort.

Fishing...
Whether you are wanting to reel in a largemouth, white bass, catfish, crappie, or sun perch, Toledo Bend has just what you are looking for!
Hunting...
Enjoy hunting the Sabine National Forest nearby for the whitetail deer of a lifetime! There are also hunting leases available locally, call for more details.
Fishing & Hunting License
Requirements
Since Toledo Bend is shared between Texas and Louisiana you can fish with Texas or Louisiana fishing licenses.
Texas hunting licenses are required for hunting Sabine National Forest or Texas land.
You can purchase your fishing license online either through Texas Parks and Wildlife or Louisiana Dept of Wildlife & Fisheries.
Toledo Bend Lunker Bass Program
Official Weigh Station
Toledo Bend Lake Association rewards anglers a replica bass for catching and releasing their Toledo Bend Lunker back to the lake. To qualify, the bass must weigh 10LBS OR MORE.
Holly Park Marina is one of five weigh stations on the Texas side of Toledo Bend.

Canyon Lake RV Park & Condos
Lake Pointe RV Resort & Condos is located along the north shore of beautiful Canyon Lake. Canyon Lake, Texas is one of the premier recreational areas between the cities of San Antonio and Austin in the Texas Hill Country. Boating, skiing, fishing, and other water sports are within easy reach as are the sights and adventures that await in the two best Texas cities for arts, entertainment, and shopping.
WAYS TO STAY
SPECIALS
Lake Pointe is Calling…
Canyon Lake Texas is a true hidden treasure of the Central Texas Hill Country. With breathtaking park and lake views; this is the place where many are starting to call home. White-tailed deer, foxes, roadrunners, and other wildlife are in abundance in the Texas Hill Country and especially at Canyon Lake. The Texas Hill Country is famous for its hilly terrain, live oak trees, limestone rocks, native animals, and clean fresh air.

Walking the Dog at Lake Pointe
May-July is Fawning Season
Photo courtesy of Texas Atras
Do not approach, do not touch…
If you see a fawn, please stay at least 50 feet away. Do not approach, touch, pick up, hold or move our deer babies. Mom will be back! It is natural for a doe to leave her baby while she forages for food, often for many hours at a time. A lone fawn is usually not an orphaned fawn. Keep dogs on leash at all times and away from the fawns.
Please tell your kids…
Please educate your children that fawns are delicate and can easily break a leg. Also, a doe will attack and injure you badly if they feel their fawn is in danger. Please leave the baby deer alone so that mom can safely return. If the fawn is visibly injured, starving or poorly responsive, contact office staff.
Check under your vehicle before driving…
Sometimes fawns are left under vehicles by their mothers. Fawns have been run over accidentally here! Please check under your vehicle and especially under each tire before moving to prevent a needless tragedy. Thanks for helping!
Fawning Season Printout
Staff and management went above and beyond…
We arrived at the park and was immediately greeted by staff personnel at the gate intercom. The Staff and management went above and beyond to help assist us In every way possible. They even arranged for us to stay one extra night in our same slot, even when it was booked. The park is fantastic, we spent most of our time in the beach area. If your wanting to stay at a nice RV park on the water, give Lake Pointe RV a call. We know we will!

So happy to have found this place!
This place is truly something special on Canyon Lake. It’s so quiet and relaxing here. The sunsets from Lake Pointe have to be some of the best on the lake. There is an abundance of all kinds of wildlife and the members, guests and staff at Lake Pointe are all down-to-earth and super friendly. So happy to have found this place!
Jason S.
Rated 5 out of 5 stars
We will always recommend this place to everyone we cross paths with…
We absolutely love this place and I’ve been coming here for years. The staff has always been warm and welcoming. Plus you get amazing views of the lake. We will always recommend this place to everyone we cross paths with.
H.J.
Rated 5 out of 5 stars
They are super nice at the front and make sure you are well taken care of…
We absolutely loved it! We parked our RV there and they made sure to give us the spot right next to the playground for our little ones. They sell deer food to feed the deer so that’s awesome! It’s for a great view of the lake, the pool is humongous, and they are always out making sure ppl are going speed limit which makes me feel safe with my kids around. They are super nice at the front and make sure you are well taken care of. They even let us borrow an adapter for our RV to plug into the electric because we didn’t have one. Thanks for a good time y’all!
Marcie L.
Rated 5 out of 5 stars
The scenery is beautiful….
I was a little nervous about the deer being around, thinking they might attack or bother us, but they were very calm. They seem used to humans, but they also don’t get too close us. You just don’t bother them, and they won’t bother you. The scenery is beautiful. There are lots of big and shady trees around the RV parking area, and a playground when you walk in as well, with a tetherball pole, swing sets, a slide, climbing rope, small rock wall, tire swing, and a bunch of picnic tables. There is also a basketball hoop and net for playing volleyball, as well as two pools. Lots of fun places are nearby too.
A.M.
Rated 5 out of 5 stars
The flowers were absolutely beautiful…
Been here for about 5 months now, and we love it here! The deer are really friendly, and the sunsets.. oh man, the sunsets are gorgeous! When we first got here in the spring, the flowers were absolutely beautiful. The staff is generally quite nice and helpful, and they have activities! I’ve honestly had a great time here. 5/5 stars would recommend!
Kaden B.
Rated 5 out of 5 stars
Lots of good family memories…
We love Lake Pointe RV & Condo! We have been members at least 10 years and have absolutely loved it. The people are great and we love being there on the lake and feeding the deer and swimming and it is just a great time there. Lots of good family memories.
The wildlife at Lake Pointe is a highlight. You can feed the deer out of your hand if you are slow and gentle with them. We have seen lots of Gray foxes. We have seen lots of squirrels, birds and racoons. We love walking the trails and exploring. The stars are amazing at night there. Do be careful of scorpions there are some there which goes with the territory.
Joel D.
Rated 5 out of 5 stars
The sunsets are beautiful and the park staff are friendly and helpful…
I call this resort my happy place. I’ve been camping here for 6 six years and have made many friends. The sunsets are beautiful and the park staff are friendly and helpful.
There are many river activities in the area as well as the beautiful Texas Hill Country. The resort also has many opportunities for activities like game night, movie night and entertainment.

Rated 5 out of 5 stars
A hidden gem…
A hidden gem in Canyon Lake! Right on the lake, close to Brookshire Brothers, huge pool, beautiful sunsets and fabulous staff.
Patsy C.

It was as if we were being welcomed home!
My husband and I have owned RV’s for years and been many places but by far this has been our favorite stop!! We have spent two months here and when I tell you from the moment our feet hit the park we were treated as family! It was as if we were being welcomed home! The staff and management care about every aspect of your stay. Everyone wears multiple hats and is so accommodating, friendly and just wonderful! Always smiling and by the time you leave they really are a part of your family! We would recommend this park to everyone! They have so many wonderful activities , tons of deer to feed and the most beautiful sunsets! And did I mention the lake is out your back door!! If you love to laugh, and enjoy every moment of your stay this is the park for you!! Until next time Lake Pointe, you all will forever be with us!!

Extended Stays
Ready to Park a While?
Home »
Ways to Stay »
Extended Stays
Long-Term RV Camping at Canyon Lake, Texas
If you’re looking for a place to call home for a while, Lake Pointe is here for you. Featuring 26 acres of lakefront wildlife area, our park is quiet and peaceful. Whether you’re a Winter Texan, snowbird, traveling worker, a road school family, or a digital nomad, you’ll love what Lake Pointe has to offer.
Winter Texans & Snowbirds
Are you looking for a sunny place to escape the harsh winters of the North? Well join our growing community of snowbirds and winter Texans on the beautiful shores of Canyon Lake, where the wintertime temperatures rarely fall below 45 degrees.
Traveling Workers
Looking for a place to live while on the job in Central Texas? You should take a look at Lake Pointe. We think you’ll find what so many of our RV visitors and long-term guests have found out… that Lake Pointe feels like home.
Digital Nomads
We have a thriving community of digital nomads and full-time remote workers. We have public wi-fi and upgrade options for higher-speed requirements. When you’re ready to leave the RV for a while, there are many beautiful places around the park to work with your laptop.
Extended RV Stay Specials
Hustle, bustle, noise and stress? Not here! Tired of the traffic, rat race, constant noise? Walk outside your RV or onto the deck and listen… hear that? That’s right, silence and peace in an increasingly chaotic world. Join us on the beautiful shores at Lake Pointe where you’ll find safety, security and be surrounded by nature.
Book a three month stay (or longer) between now and February 1, and you will receive $100.00 off the 3rd month!
Already living the dream at Lake Pointe?
Refer a friend who stays with us at least 3 months and you both receive $100.00 off the 3rd month. Extended Stay Rates beginning at just $450.00 per month.
The RV Community is Like Family
Full-Time RV Living in Canyon Lake, Texas
Learn what makes full-time RV living so special. Our extended-stay guests have discovered a slower pace and a more engaged, personable community experience you just don’t see in other communities these days.

RV Sites
Lake Pointe RV & Condo Resort is a great place to stay!
Offering more than 50 acres of beautiful hill country landscape overlooking the spectacular Canyon Lake, the resort offers a variety of RV sites to make your stay perfect. In total, there are currently 89 RV full hook-up and partial hook-up sites available
Please note, that while we may have RV sites available for “drive-up” selection, we strongly urge you to call and inquire about site availability and reservations prior to arrival. Reservations take calls from 9am to 5pm Monday through Friday. All sites must be paid in full at time of booking to hold the space.
The public can make reservations up to 6 months in advance.
Check-in and Check-out are at 1pm.
Early Check-ins may be available, if needed. Early check-in is at 9 a.m. and may incur an additional $25 fee.
Electricity is included in the daily Public Rate.

Reservation Request
Extended Stays
Looking for a place to put down your wheels for a little longer stay? A place where the stars are bright and the evenings are quiet? A place where you can sit and reflect in solitude or meet up with friends to share a laugh or two? Lake Pointe RV Resort and Condos is definitely that place!
Give us a call at 830-935-4351 for significantly discounted monthly rates.
RV Site Limitations
Each paid RV site comes with 1 vehicle and up to 4 Adults . Any additional adults will be an extra charge (see below)
Additional Adults
Maximum Occupancy Level of 8 adults per RV site
Any additional adults will incur a charge of $10.00 per person, per day. Children are not counted towards that number. During Holidays, rates go to $20.00 per person. Contact reservations for details on dates we apply the Holiday Rate to.
Additional Vehicles
Any additional vehicles per RV site will incur a charge of $10.00 per vehicle for a parking permit for the duration of the stay. Parking is limited, so only 1 vehicle should be parked at the RV site. Additional paid vehicles will need to park in overflow parking that is closest to the site. During Holidays, rates go to $20.00 per person. Contact reservations for details on dates we apply the Holiday Rate to.
Visitors Coming to See Registered Guests or Members
Visitors or additional guests that wish to enter the park must stop by the office to sign in and are subject to a $10.00 parking permit fee per visit. They will need to ask the Guest Services staff where they should park. During Holidays, rates go to $20.00 per person. Contact reservations for details on dates we apply the Holiday Rate to.
Check In/Out Times
Check in time for RV sites is 1:00 PM. We may be able to accommodate an early arrival at 9 a.m., but please call ahead to verify availability. Guaranteed early check in may be available for $25.00.
Check out time for RV sites is also 1:00 PM. We may be able to offer a late check out for an extra $25.00, but let the office know as soon as possible to verify if this is an option. Late check will allow you to stay until 5pm.
Cancellation Policy
We require at least 24 hours advanced notice should you need to cancel. Cancellations must be communicated by phone call during business hours. Cancellations are subject to a $15.00 re-booking fee. If you are able to cancel prior to 24 hours, you will be issued an account credit (less the re-booking fee) in the amount that you paid so you can re-schedule your reservation. We are a no refund policy park. There are no refunds for cancellations or early departures regardless of the reason. No extra charge for sunshine!
In the event the park needs to close due to inclement weather or other emergencies, we will provide you a credit for your stay of those funds not used. The credit will remain valid for one year from the date of issue.
No calls/No Shows will forfeit their ability to reschedule their stay and will not receive a credit to use in the future and funds will not be transferable to a new reservation.
Holidays and Peak Times: There is a 2-night minimum reservation, and no coupons or other discounts will be accepted.

Tent Camping
Tent Camping at Canyon Lake, Texas
Home »
Ways to Stay »
Tent Camping
Tent Camping with Hook-Ups: $50/night
Hookups include 110V/30A power and potable water spigot.
Includes: 2 Adults and 2 children 12 and under.
Add $15 per night for each additional adult or child.
Add $10 per additional vehicle per night.
Limit 6 persons per site.
Check-Out: 11 a.m.
Primitive Tent Camping: $40/night
Lake Point’s primitive camping areas feature stunning views of Canyon Lake and our 20+ acre wild landscape we call The Pointe. These sites are true primitive sites and do not have water or electricity but are a short walk to shower and restroom facilities. Each site includes a picnic table, a fire pit and an enforced trash can.
Includes: 2 Adults and 2 children 12 and under.
Add $10 per night for each additional adult or child.
Add $10 per additional vehicle per night.
Limit 6 persons per site.
Check-Out: 11 a.m.
Food Storage & Trash Handling
Please take care to safely store your food items when leaving the site or going to bed. Our wild friends will likely raid your camp and make a mess. Please clean up after yourself and everyone in your crew. Keep our park beautiful for future visitors. Leave no trace.
Can I Have A Fire?
Be sure to check to see if a burn ban is in effect in Comal County before starting a fire.
Site Options
Primitive Site #1
Shaded lakeview primitive campsite near the clubhouse, pools, showers, and restroom facilities. There is plenty of shade. Sites do not have electricity or water.
Primitive Site #2
Shaded lakeview primitive campsite near the clubhouse, pools, showers, and restroom facilities. There is plenty of shade. Sites do not have electricity or water.
Primitive Site #3
Shaded lakeview primitive campsite near the clubhouse, pools, showers, and restroom facilities. There is plenty of shade. Sites do not have electricity or water.
Camping with a large group?
Lake Pointe features many acres of open, shaded camping areas for larger gatherings, if required. We also have two event venues nearby that can be reserved for your event or private gathering.
Please call us at 830-935-4351 if you’re interested in primitive tent camping.

A Hub at the Center of Endless Hill Country Exploration
We believe that your Texas Hill Country adventure should be filled with excitement and relaxation. Our park is centrally located, making it the perfect base camp for exploring nearby state parks, breweries, wineries, shops, and hiking trails. After a day of adventure, our park offers a peaceful retreat where you can unwind, recharge, and prepare for your next day of exploration.

Meet Miller
“Howdy, I’m Miller! I’m a modern-day explorer with a thirst for escape, adventure, and a life well-lived. Nothin’ suits me better than strikin’ out into the unknown and seein’ what I can find along the way. Stickin’ ‘round one spot for too long makes me restless as a windstorm, so I had to get to goin’ out into the unknown.
“After some time spent wanderin’, I done come upon a creek and kept followin’ it. Why? I don’t know, but y’all’dve never guessed what appeared before my eyes: a haven by the name of Miller Creek RV Park. Towering Live Oaks rustled quietly in the breeze, and best of all, I met people like me all lookin’ for the same things I was: a soft place to land in the midst of a life of freedom and adventure.
“Now that I had a hub to call home, I began exploring the many personalities of the Texas Hill Country and came upon more than I could’ve imagined. Wineries, local arts and culture, lip-smackin’ good food, and hiking trails winding through the Hill Country. A little somethin’ for everyone to enjoy.
“When you’re ready to check out, check in to Miller Creek RV Park, your Hill Country Restination.”
– Miller

Angie
“It's a nice park, nestled into the TX hill country, where you can relax and get back to nature. It's not too far from several towns if you need something, but not so close that you have to deal with town problems. I saw a lot of wildlife while I was there, and generally had a great time.”

PERFECT FOR WINTER TEXANS – PERFECT FOR VACATIONERS
Book your site now
Oleander Acres RV Park
Mission, Texas
Tucked away in the tropical climate of the lower Rio Grande Valley in Mission, Texas, Oleander Acres is a perfect escape for retirees, Winter Texans and other vacationers. Oleander Acres is a quiet Christian getaway with 23 lush acres and sweeping vistas of South Texas. Vacationers and full-time RVers alike will appreciate the quiet of the countryside and fun activities. Oleander Acres welcomes you to try a friendly RV community surrounded by an abundance of natural beauty.
We are opened year round and offer Winter Texans the most affordable full-service RV campground in Texas’ Rio Grande Valley. Our 300 full service hookups and 10 park model rentals can accommodate your budget and your RV needs.
Mission, Texas also provides a superior climate with more sun, less rain and humidity than surrounding areas. There’s always plenty to do since we’re only minutes from golf courses, huge flea markets and the World Birding Centers of the South Texas Rio Grande Valley and less than an hour from fishing and beach combing on South Padre Island TX.
We invite you to share our park with us
book now
For more information
(956) 585-9093
Paradise for Winter Texans
We love to welcome snowbirds from all over the country and Canada! Fall through Spring are beautiful here at Oleander Acres. The weather is pleasant, and it’s a great place to escape the frigid temperatures in the north and enjoy activities, friendships, and site-seeing in the area.
Lifetime friendships have been developed by our visitors during their winter stays at Oleander Acres. After a summer away, many come back year after year to catch up with friends. Whether you want to come and just get away from it all and have a peaceful time by yourself, or whether you want to participate fully in all of the events and activities, spending the winter at Oleander Acres in Mission, Texas is sure to be an enjoyable time for you.

Welcome to Port Isabel Park Center, LLC
Located in the Southern tropical tip of Texas in the Historic town of Port Isabel, just before you cross the causeway to South Padre Island.
Port Isabel Park Center is a fully gated community. We pride ourselves in our friendly staff and great service. We are working towards becoming the best RV park for boating, fishing, and relaxing in south Texas. Come and enjoy our new Rec Hall pool, lighted fishing piers, floating boat docks, quiet atmosphere, and friendly attitude. We're just a short drive to several birding and wildlife refuges, the sun and fun of South Padre Island, and lots of great shopping and dinning. Bring your golf carts, boats, jet skies, and fishing equipment. We want to be your home away from home.
about

AND
ATTRACTIONS
The Laguna Madre encompasses the bay area of Port Isabel, South Padre Island and Laguna Vista. Our subtropical climate, culture and history make the city a favorite destination for millions of tourists. We hope you will be among them.
​
Enjoy a clean atmosphere for a day, a week, a month or more! We are sure you will find yourself at home. Pets, tents and pop ups are always welcome. We invite you to stay with us soon! Our sites are plentiful, spacious and ready for your stay. Please note this facility and activities are for the residents of Port Isabel Park Center guests only
​
Port Isabel and South Padre Island are great vacation places. The year round tropical climate and warm Gulf and Bay waters make this the perfect place for watersports such as windsurfing and kiteboarding. Others love our great fishing, beach walking, birdwatching and laid back island lifestyle.

Piney Ridge RV Park offers a relaxing getaway amongst lots of trees and shade. With a safe, gated community and high-speed fiber internet, it's the perfect spot for anyone looking for a great outdoor adventure.
Lots of Trees & Shade
With a variety of trees providing natural shade, you can enjoy your outdoor activities while keeping cool and comfortable.
Gated Community
Our gated community offers privacy and security, allowing you to relax and enjoy your time at the park without the worry of unwanted visitors.
High Speed Internet
We offer high-speed internet, perfect for streaming, gaming, or surfing the web. Our internet is fast, reliable, and secure, so you can stay connected without worry.
Welcome to Tyler, TX
Rose Capital of the World
Tyler is known as the "Rose Capital of America" (also the "Rose City" and the "Rose Capital of the World"), a nickname it earned from a long history of rose production, cultivation, and processing. It is home to the largest rose garden in the United States, a 14-acre public garden complex that has over 38,000 rose bushes of at least 500 different varieties. The Tyler Rose Garden is also home to the annual Texas Rose Festival, attracting tourists by the thousands each year in mid-October.
/
Rich History
Central Tyler is anchored by Brick Streets Historic District and Charnwood Residential Historic District, areas characterized by dense retail, restaurants, nightlife, and historic landmarks.
Education and Health
As Northeast Texas and Smith County's major economic, educational, financial, medical and cultural hub, Tyler is host to more than 20,000 higher-education students, the University of Texas at Tyler, a university health science center, and regional hospital systems.

HISTORIC PRUDE RANCH
EXPERIENCE PRUDE RANCH
A perfect getaway Since 1897
Historic Prude Ranch has evolved over the years to offer educational programing, family reunions, fitness camps, RV camping, and experiential learning. We continue to offer trail rides through our scenic mountain ranges, and an idyllic retreat from city living. Our summer camp experience allow youth to discover, create, connect, and explore. They build lifelong friendships, learn to be more independent, build resilience, and uncover their passion.
We are proud to host diverse groups such as the Texas Star Party, many fellowship groups, public and private schools, birdwatching groups, cyclists, corporate retreats, weddings square dancers, and so much more!
While we continue to evolve our offerings, we remain steadfast in our commitment to preserve the the natural beauty of this historic land. We invite you to explore our website and look forward to welcoming you to the Ranch soon.
