Facilities & accommodation
accommodation
Several options are available to meet the needs of our diverse guests. From cozy family cabins for individual families to Bunkhouses that hold up to 20 cowpokes; we have an option for you or your group!
Hillside Cabins
Our Guest Lodges are a popular choice for guests. Rooms are modestly furnished with one to two beds, air conditioning/heating, and a coffee pot. Prude Ranch does not offer TV or kitchenettes in our motel rooms, however we do provide them in our Lodge. Our motel rooms comfortably sleep 1-4 guests.
$129 /Night
Hillside Suite
The 2-bedroom Hillside Suite features beautiful views of the mountains, air conditioning/heating, 2 bathrooms with tub showers, a full kitchen, living area, coffee maker, and WiFi.
Bedroom 1 features two full-sized beds.
Bedroom 2 features a queen-sized bed.
$249 /night
RV Campsites
Escape the city and enjoy the starry nights at Prude Ranch. Book a single night (from $30) or stay for a full month with water, sewer hookups, and electricity (30 & 50 amp).
From $30 /Night
Bunkhouses
Bunkhouses are the perfect choice for larger groups. These cabins sleep 8-20 persons at a time and have multiple shower & bathroom facilities. They can be rented with or without linens.
Only Available for Group Rentals. (Group Booking Requires +20 Participants).
Inquire Now
Family Cabins
Family Cabins are another popular choice for guests, especially families. These cabins are furnished with a queen or king bed and bunk beds along with air conditioning/heating and a coffee pot. These cabins do not have TV or kitchenette. Family cabins comfortably sleep 2-6 guests.
Inquire Now
Walnut Family Cabin
Walnut has 3 rooms with 2 beds each, 2 bathrooms, and a living area with a fireplace.
minimum 2 night stay required
Inquire Now
Facilities
As a guest on Prude Ranch, you will have access to a host of facilities and amenities. Explore the trails, exercise on the courts, grill at the cookout area, or relax in our lodge. We have something to keep the entire group entertained.
Horse Corral
Our horses are at the center of everything we do on the Ranch.
Dining Room
Our dining room has the capacity to seat 125. The unique design provides the perfect setting for special occasions.
Hiking & Riding Trails
Explore the land on horseback or foot - right outside your cabin door.
Lodge
Hangout and enjoy coffee, games, TV, and wifi in our lodge or work up a sweat in the workout room next door.
Climbing Wall & Challenge Course
Overcome your fear of heights on our climbing wall and exhilarate your senses on our challenge course
Cookout Area
Flip some burgers, hot dogs, or steak, then roast some s’mores under the stars.
Swimming Pool
Our large indoor swimming pool is open from Spring Break through to Thanksgiving.
Tennis & Basketball Courts
Enjoy a little friendly competition on on our courts.
Gym/Auditorium
Use as a meeting space for your group or a banquet hall.
Pavillion
Gather your group at our open-air pavilion or set up for some evening square dancing.

your prude ranch Adventure
countdown to camp
Since 1951, Historic Prude Ranch has offered boys and girls a true 'Southwest' experience - wide open spaces, beautiful mountains, clear, pure air, pleasant temperatures and a sample of real ranch life. Today, six generations later, Prude Ranch Summer Camp is still a family affair and the children who come every summer leave with that close knit feeling of family participation, so important to their development.
FRIENDSHIPS
ADVENTURE
PRESERVATION
THE TIME OF YOUR LIFE
camp friends are the best friends.
That’s right… you’ll meet friends for life at Prude Ranch. COMMUNITY and CONNECTION are engrained in our DNA. When we remove screen time and introduce the great outdoors, bunk life, and talks around the campfire; we connect based on mutual interests, laughter, learning, and personal growth.
SIGN UP TO MEET NEW FRIENDS
ADVENTURE.
No adventure compares to a camp adventure! At Prude Ranch you’ll learn archery, riflery, leather work, roping, sports, and swimming. You’ll go on trail rides, hikes, and even campouts in the Davis Mountains. You’ll explore all day and play all night!
SIGN UP FOR YOUR ADVENTURE
We believe that we are custodians of the land, our rich heritage, and our family values.
PRESERVATION.
Sign up to experience nature
the time of your life!
Endless games, cheer, camaraderie, and programs designed to make you laugh out loud! Come experience Prude Ranch for an adventure that will leave you wanting more!
Sign up for the time of your life!

Pet Policies for Quail Springs RV Park Guests
All pets must be controlled on an 8-foot or shorter leash at all times while outside. Pets cannot be turned loose, tied out unattended, or in a pen or kennel.
Walk pets in your yard or "Common Areas" only. Do not allow them to walk into any other yards. Keep them on the road until you get to the "Common Areas".
Pet owners are responsible for the immediate cleanup of pet droppings. If your pet has issues and you can't pick it up, please carry water with you, pick up what you can and wash it down so no one comes along and steps in it. If you don't have water with you at the time, pick up what you can & mark the spot with the bag. Come back immediately with water to wash it away.
Pets will not be allowed in the buildings at any time.
We know dogs bark and can't be quiet all the time, but if they cannot stop barking, take them inside.
No animal that is aggressive to people or other animals will be tolerated.
You will be warned once only. The second violation will result in eviction. All pets must be current on all vaccinations and be free of communicable diseases.
Upon arriving at our park, you will be required to sign a form acknowledging that you have read our policies and have agreed to comply with them.
MANAGEMENT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADDRESS ANY PROBLEM PET AND DEAL WITH IT ACCORDING TO THEIR DISCRETION.

Frio River Fun

Events
River Rim Resort is the perfect place to have a Frio River wedding, a family reunion, or a corporate retreat.
Pets are welcome
Most pets are part of the family. We’re happy to accommodate them.
River Rim Resort
… is a hidden treasure in the Texas Hill Country sitting on five beautiful acres over-looking the pristine Frio River. Located at 1204 CR 350 between Concan and Garner State Park, the Rim offers visitors exceptional private river access as well as a picturesque swimming pool complex called The Spring at the Rim.
Some guests choose to stay in the cluster of cabins that resemble a village accented with a European flair. River Rim is the perfect place for friends and family to gather for a fun infused vacation or a sought after romantic weekend get-away.
The resort is open year-round and offers a splendid place to vacation or to host family reunions, weddings, or corporate retreats. The Rim also offers guest accommodations at its sister resort Lost Canyon Retreat. Let the Rim become your “home away from home” in the Frio Canyon, but there is a WARNING–visiting River Rim and its sister resorts can be habit forming.

RV Ranch of Keene in Keene, TX
RV Ranch of Keene is a welcoming RV park in Keene, TX, offering comfort, convenience, and easy access to local attractions. Ideal for both short and long-term stays, the park features spacious pull-through sites with full hookups, including 20/30/50 amp power, city water, and sewer connections. Guests enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, free cable TV, secure surroundings, and pet-friendly accommodations, creating a relaxing and worry-free experience.
The park offers amenities designed for comfort, including two pools, private family-style bathhouses, large laundry facilities, a catch-and-release pond, and a well-lit, secure environment. Conveniently located near Cleburne State Park, Fort Worth Stockyards, Pirates’ Cove Fun Zone, and Dinosaur Valley State Park, it provides the perfect base for exploring Johnson County. Open year-round, RV Ranch of Keene combines quality amenities, a friendly atmosphere, and a convenient location for a memorable RV stay.

Scenic View Motel & RV Park
LONE STAR WEATHER
Welcome to the perfect getaway, Scenic View Motel, Marina & RV Park in Lone Star, Texas.
Established in the mid-1940s, this property has been a hidden jewel for nearly eighty years.
Lone Star Lake is definitely off the beaten path. Through the years, the lake has retained its peaceful beauty and it remains a great place to “get away from it all”.
We moved from the Dallas area in 1998 and nothing has been the same since. We enjoy life, our family, and nature. Here, we have found a little piece of heaven on earth and are eager to share it with you, your family, and friends.
Aren’t you ready for a break from your busy life? Isn’t it time to relax and have some fun?”
~ Kim & Jim Sly, Owners
Lone Star Lake is a great recreation lake. You can have a terrific time fishing, swimming, water skiing, tubing, wakeboarding, riding a jet ski, cruising the lake on a barge or in a boat, or just sitting on the bank enjoying the beauty of the tall pine trees and beautiful scenery.
In addition, almost everyone who stays here agrees, this lake has the most incredible sunsets that you have ever seen.
CLICK HERE
FOR RESERVATIONS!
Enjoy Your Stay
Our property includes over 100 yards of shoreline, a large boat dock, a smaller fishing dock, a swimming area, and two boat ramps. We have a variety of cooking areas as well as outdoor games.
This is a great place to stay, with numerous outdoor activities available. Local bass clubs host Lone Star Lake Fishing Tournaments each year, and this is a favored place to stay. In addition, it is an ideal choice for those attending Lake O’ the Pines Fishing Tournaments , which is only minutes away.
Rustic Cabin
Relaxation is a breeze in our rustic cabin! With amazing views of the lake, the cozy smell of pine, and all the comforts of home, you won’t want to leave.
Sit on the porch, pop a cold one by the fire, and watch the beautiful sunset after a day of fishing & grillin’!
The rustic cabin is just a few steps from the patio area and the scenic overlook.
Queen Size Log Bed

Lodging
Our Motel has 6-units. All of our rooms are kitchenettes complete with 2 burner electric stove, microwave oven, breakfast table and chairs, and a small refrigerator. Each room is equipped with a small safe to keep your valuables in. All the modern conveniences of home!
We take pride in our clean and comfortable rooms! Great rates to go along with the Great View!

RV Park
We have 25 RV Sites for all types of RV’s. All sites are full hookups that is: water connection, electricity (20/30/50 amp breakers), and sewer. Cable is available too! We have B-B-Q’s for our guests to use. Pets are allowed in the campground as long as there are kept on leashes.
Oh and you do have to clean up after your pets!

Marina & Lake Activities
This is a great fishing lake. It receives very little fishing pressure, resulting in a substantial fish population. The good fishing has resulted in numerous bass clubs holding club tournaments here each year. A good challenging time can be found on this lake. Are you up for a good challenge?
The lake was built in 1943. The area of the lake is 1,516 acres of water, 29+ miles of shoreline with water depth from 4′ to 45′. The lake record bass was caught on February 25, 2017. The largemouth bass weighed 11.45 pounds and was 24.5 inches long. It was weighed at the Scenic View Motel, RV Park & Marina’s store and released. As far as we know, it is waiting to be caught and weighed again. The weight of fish caught ranges from 1 to 10 pounds.
Local Bass Clubs have found this is an excellent place to stay for Lone Star Lake (Ellison Reservoir) Fishing Tournaments . You will be right on the water.
It is also an excellent place to stay for Lake O’ the Pines Fishing Tournaments . These events occur numerous times throughout the year, and it can be challenging to find motel rooms or RV sites. Lake O’ the Pines is only three miles away from Scenic View, making it easy to get to the fishing ramps.
All the fish that have been brought in and weighed have been released back into the lake. We look forward to a good spawn, ensuring there will always be plenty of fish to be found here.

Lake O’ the Pines Motel & RV Park
Your Gateway to Lake O’ the Pines, TX – Stay Just 3 Miles Away at Scenic View Motel & RV Park!
Looking for the perfect place to stay near Lake O’ the Pines ? Whether you’re chasing trophy bass , entering one of the many Lake O’ the Pines fishing tournaments , or simply escaping into East Texas nature, Scenic View Motel & RV Park offers the ideal blend of comfort, affordability, and lakeside charm— just 3 miles from the action .
We’re a highly-rated, mom & pop motel and RV park , located right on the peaceful shores of Lone Star Lake (Ellison Reservoir) . That means you get the best of both worlds: quick access to Lake O’ the Pines and a quiet, relaxing place to unwind at the end of the day.
Fish Lake O’ the Pines – East Texas Fishing at Its Finest
Lake O’ the Pines is a true East Texas treasure. Known for exceptional fishing , it’s home to:
Largemouth bass
White and black crappie
Catfish
Bluegill and sunfish
And more!
With its abundant structure, submerged timber, and healthy ecosystem, Lake O’ the Pines is a hotspot for serious anglers and a frequent host to regional and national fishing tournaments .
Here for a Lake O’ the Pines Fishing Tournament?
Whether you’re fishing solo or part of a big tournament crowd, Scenic View Motel & RV Park is the smart choice for Lake O’ the Pines lodging . We’re just minutes from the boat ramps, and we offer:
Clean, quiet motel rooms
A private cabin for extra space
Full-hookup RV spaces
Super reasonable rates
Plenty of parking for your boat and trailer
Don’t waste time driving from a crowded hotel in town—stay close to the lake and closer to the fish !
Affordable Lake O’ the Pines RV Park Alternative
Looking for Lake O’ the Pines RV parks but want a spot that’s clean, quiet, and budget-friendly? Our RV sites at Scenic View come with:
Easy access pull-through sites
Full hookups (water, sewer, electric)
Beautiful lake views
Picnic areas and space to breathe
You’ll be just 3 miles from Lake O’ the Pines but surrounded by the natural beauty of Lone Star Lake , where eagles soar overhead and peace comes standard.
Beyond the Bass – Birdwatching & Nature Activities Galore
Scenic View Motel & RV Park is more than just a fishing destination. We’re also a birdwatcher’s paradise and a perfect place to soak in East Texas’ natural beauty.
Spot Bald Eagles, ospreys, herons, egrets, and songbirds
Enjoy peaceful mornings by the lake
Capture amazing wildlife photos
Go for relaxing strolls along the water
Nature lovers , couples, families, and weekend wanderers will all find something to love here. There’s plenty to do besides cast a line!
Clean, Cozy & Affordable – Stay at Scenic View Motel & RV Park
We’re proud to be a mom & pop-run motel and RV park , where guests are treated like friends. Our accommodations are:
✅ Spotlessly clean
✅ Comfortable and quiet
✅ Perfect for fishing trips, nature getaways, or family weekends
✅ Priced right—no inflated resort fees here!
Choose from:
Well-kept motel rooms with everything you need
A private cabin with extra room and rustic charm
RV spaces with full hookups and easy access
⭐
Why Guests Keep Coming Back
“Perfect place for fishing Lake O’ the Pines. Clean rooms, great rates, and just a short drive to the lake!”
“We came for a tournament and ended up booking for the whole week. Loved the peaceful setting.”
“Birds, fishing, friendly owners—what else do you need?”
Don’t Miss Your Perfect Lake O’ the Pines Stay
If you’re looking for the best Lake O’ the Pines motel or an RV park near Lake O’ the Pines , look no further. Scenic View Motel & RV Park is your ideal launch point for fishing, birdwatching, and relaxing East Texas adventures.
Located on Lone Star Lake (Ellison Reservoir) – Only 3 miles to Lake O’ the Pines
Clean, comfy rooms and RV spaces
Wildlife, peace, and natural beauty
Prices that leave more in your tackle box
Call now at 903.656.2272 or text 903.767.0031 to reserve your stay!

The Village
This cozy little park is nestled in a mott of Live Oaks, at the outskirts of the Texas coastal village of Rockport. In the morning you can hear the distant throb of shrimp & oyster boat motors, in the evening you can walk Fulton Beach Rd. next to the shoreline and see dolphins hunting the shallows for trout.
It's called the Village because many of Texas life's little necessities are available right there. Stevie Lew's BBQ Kitchen offers delicious meals and features an ice cream and dessert bar to enjoy, Rockport Coffee Co. roasts the finest coffees in the world making your morning wake-up call worth waking up for! Good neighbors, good fishing, good memories, it's what Seaport Village is all about.

Welcome to Serendipity Bay ​RV Resort, Cabins, & Marina Make Reservation
Serendipity Bay Rv resort and marina
Serendipity Bay RV Resort and Marina is located in the quaint seaside town of Palacios, Texas. Nestled on 17 acres, you get a special feeling of community and wonderful friends combined with beaches, seaside boardwalk, fishing, shopping and much more makes for an amazing experience. Whether you stay a day, a week or a year, our resort is sure to deliver a memorable experience.
Our amenities include a tropical swimming pool, fitness center, children's play area, shuffleboard, bocce ball, recreational room and party hall, lighted fishing pier, fish cleaning station and much more. We are sure you will make Serendipity Bay RV Resort and Marina the destination of choice for your family vacation. Bring your RV or your boat! No worries if you don't have an RV, we have cabins, rental RVs, and a bay house for rent!
Our resort in Palacios is located off Highway 35 on Main Street, just north of Port Lavaca and a short drive to Bay City. If you like festivals, then put us on your calendar! Shrimp, Oyster, Crawfish, Gumbo, BBQ and Chili cook-offs combined with live music, crafts and children’s activities are spread throughout the year. Join us for our famous Matagorda Bay Birdfest in March, Pedal Palacios in October, and our annual Seaside Holiday Boat Parade in November!
Our amenities
The Texas Coast is full of features that set it apart from the rest of Texas. The same is true for Serendipity Bay RV Resort and Marina. We host all the conveniences of home in the atmosphere of the beautiful sunrises and sandy beaches.

Welcome to Skyline Ranch RV Park
Quiet country atmosphere in the beautiful Texas Hill Country just a mile from historic Bandera, Texas, "The Cowboy Capital of the World." A quick glance at your map will show you Bandera's location nestled between the world class attractions, services, medical care, history, and charm of San Antonio, Austin, Kerrville and all points in between. The 103 sites are mostly pull-thrus and accommodate big rigs with multiple slide-outs. Many sites have majestic oaks and other large trees, but there are ample open sites, also. The Skyline Ranch offers extensive water frontage on the beautiful Medina River, just a short 1/4 mile walk from your RV site. There is a large picnic area overlooking the river. Nature trails provide a great opportunity to view white tail and axis deer, wild turkeys and numerous bird species. Also, trophy Texas Longhorn steers and miniature donkeys can be viewed in the scenic pecan orchard. Great for photography buffs, artists, birders, fishermen and women, readers, agriculturalists, water lovers, naturalists, bikers, cyclers, and you!
And don't worry, if home or work calls, handle it with the confidence of FREE High-Speed Wi-Fi.

Welcome to
South Forty RV Park
3689 S. Hwy 77 ~ Giddings, TX 78942
Come on by the ranch and meet the Longhorn cattle - we just love company. We offer fantastic amenities at our
Texas RV Park located just six miles south of Giddings, Texas. You'll enjoy full hook-ups (water, sewer, electric), and a pool. If y'all just want to relax, pull up a chair on the front porch and enjoy the sunset or sit by the waterfall, watching the birds and squirrels at play. You bookworms might want to borrow a good book from the park's lending library for lying beside the pool, catching up on some reading. No matter how you choose to spend your time, you will enjoy a great stay at
South Forty RV Park!
Howdy, folks - I'm Lily Longhorn, your heifer host for this Internet tour of
South Forty RV Park ! I used to travel the rodeo circuit, showin' off my ropin' tricks. These days I'm enjoying the "quiet life" here at the South Forty Longhorn Ranch and can't wait for all
you friendly RVers to stop by to see us at the finest
RV park near Giddings. When the Ross family, owners and managers of South Forty, asked me to host their Website, I was happy to oblige. After all, I'm still a showgirl and there's nothing I like better than tellin' folks like yourselves about the great attractions in Lee County, Texas.
You can make our park into your home base while you head out to explore attractions like the Lee County Heritage Center, the Round Top Antiques Fair, and Bastrop State Park. You'll enjoy great Texas activities like fishing and swimming at Lake Somerville or golfing at the Giddings Country Club.
South Forty RV Park is set in a wooded area on State Highway 77, 6 miles south of Giddings, Texas and 12 miles north of La Grange, Texas. The park is part of the Ross' South Forty Longhorn Ranch, a ranch dedicated to preserving the Texas Longhorn cattle breed. This is an RV getaway with excellent facilities, a serene country atmosphere, and customer service that aims to please. Far from being just another "RV Parkin' Lot," our park is designed with your privacy and recreational enjoyment in mind.

The Beginning meter reading will be taken on the 1st. day Guest occupies the RV Site. Campground will assess a $25.00 one time late fee plus $5.00 per day past the due date if the total amount of Fees or any other charge due under the terms of this Agreement is not received within 5 days after the due date.
6. Deposit: Upon the Effective Date of this Agreement, Guest agrees to pay Campground $250.00 for Guest’s use of electrical power on the RV Site (“Electric Deposit”). The Electric Deposit shall be refunded to Guest upon termination or expiration of this Agreement provided Guest has not committed any Acts of Default (as defined below) and has fulfilled all other provisions of the Agreement, including the covenant to occupy the RV Site, pay fees and other charges due for the full term of the Agreement.
7. Rules and Regulations: Guest and their invitees and all occupants shall comply with the written rules and regulations provided to Guest (a copy of which are attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herein for all intents and purposes). Guest agrees to comply with all state and federal laws, rules, ordinances and regulations applicable to the property. Guest agrees to comply with any and all changes in the rules or regulations that the Park Owner may make.
8. Campground’s Right to Terminate Agreement: Campground may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason by providing User a notice to vacate the RV Site (“Notice to Vacate”). User agrees to render peaceful possession of the RV Site to Campground within three (3) days of the date provided on the Notice to Vacate. The three (3) days notice shall not be required to terminate if termination is the result of an Act of Default (as defined in #10 below). Upon Guest’s peaceful surrender of the RV Site to Campground and subject to the provisions of paragraph 6 of this Agreement, Campground will refund to Guest the proportionate amount of any unused Fees previously paid by Guest to Campground.
9. Early Termination by Guest: Campground may recover as damages for Guest’s early termination of this Agreement an amount equal to the amount of Fees, other amounts owed that remain outstanding for the Term of the Agreement, Campground’s court costs and legal fees.
10. Default by Guest: The following acts constitute defaults by Guest (“Acts of Default”):
a) Failure to timely pay Fees or other lawful charges when due under this Agreement;
b) Giving false information on any application to Campground;
c) Guest, Guest’s guests and/or occupants failure to comply with any rule or regulation or term, covenant or condition of this Agreement;
d) Guest has materially breached the terms of this Agreement by an action such as violating provisions of this Agreement or committing serious misconduct or criminal acts;
e) Guest holds over after giving notice of termination and intent to vacate; and/or
f) Guest holds over after Campground gives notice of termination at the end of the Term or a Notice to Vacate during the Term in accordance with paragraph 8 of this Agreement.
11. Condition of RV Site: By execution of this Agreement, Guest acknowledges and agrees that the RV Site is neat and clean and adequate for Guest’s use. Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, Guest agrees to surrender the RV Site to Campground in a neat and clean condition.
12. Assignment: Guest shall not have the right to assign or sublet the RV Site hereunder to any person or persons.
13. Governing Law: This Agreement is governed and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Texas.
14. Attorney Fees: In the event any legal proceedings of any kind are instituted to collect unpaid Fees, electrical charges or for possession of the RV Site, Campground may collect from Guest all reasonable costs and attorney fees incurred by Campground in pursuing such action.
15. Waiver: Campground’s failure to insist on strict compliance with terms, covenants, or conditions of this Agreement shall not be deemed a waiver of that term, covenant or condition, nor shall any waiver or relinquishment of any right or power at any one time or times be deemed a waiver or relinquishment of the right or power for all or any other times.
16. Notices: All written notices and communications regarding this Agreement should be hand delivered or mailed to the designated undersigned persons at the Campground store/post office unless notified in writing to the contrary by the receiving party. The notice shall become effective as of the date of mailing by regular mail or the date a hand delivered notice is received.
17. THE CAMPGROUND SHALL NOT BE LIABLE TO THE GUEST FOR ANY DAMAGES ARISING OUT OF ANY ACTIONS OR NEGLIGENCE ON THE PART OF ANY OTHER CAMPGROUND GUEST OR RESIDENT OR THEIR FAMILIES, AGENTS, EMPLOYEES OR INVITEES. GUEST AGREES TO PAY THE CAMPGROUND FOR ANY DAMAGES CAUSED BY GUEST, GUEST’S FAMILY, AGENTS, INVITEES OR EMPLOYEES.
THEFT OF SERVICE LAW
ACCORDING TO TEXAS PENAL CODE SECTION 31:04 (b), any guest who leaves without paying for site services or who refuses to pay for site services when due is subject to criminal prosecution. We are providing service hook-ups for your RV. We require full payment in advance and will prosecute any violations under the “THEFT OF SERVICES LAW”

I also agree to vacate the premises at the request of management if I violate any rules or regulations, without a refund of any prepaid fees.

Welcome to The Palms RV Resort
Excellent park. Exceptional stay.
The Palms RV Park is a welcoming RV park in Aransas Pass, Texas, offering premium concrete motorcoach and RV pads in the heart of coastal Texas. Conveniently located eight miles from both Rockport and Port Aransas, the park is only minutes from the beautiful waters of the Gulf of Mexico.

Discover The Palms RV Park in Aransas Pass, Texas.
Enjoy the beaches of Port Aransas and Aransas Pass, local festivals, market days, community events, and excellent fishing from the shore, a boat, or one of the area’s many piers. Take the ferry to Port Aransas for excellent dining, coastal attractions, and a relaxing day by the water. We hope to welcome you soon for a fun and relaxing stay.
If you’re looking for a top-tier RV park in Texas that combines luxury, convenience, and coastal charm, The Palms RV Park in Aransas Pass, Texas, is the perfect choice. With premium amenities, spacious RV pads, and a prime location near the Gulf Coast, this RV park provides everything you need for a memorable getaway. Whether you’re staying for a weekend, a season, or longer, The Palms RV Park stands out as one of the best RV parks in Aransas Pass, Texas.
Made for extended stays
Comfort and convenience for traveling workers in Texas.
The Palms RV Park offers a welcoming and accommodating environment for healthcare professionals, construction workers, and mobile project teams seeking long-term RV stays in Texas.
Spacious full-hookup sites
Premium concrete pads with 30-amp and 50-amp electrical service for RVs of all sizes.
Everyday convenience
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, on-site laundry facilities, clean bathhouses, and family restrooms.
Room to recharge
A solar-heated swimming pool, gas-heated hot tub, spacious clubhouse, organized events, and a dedicated dog park.
Our resort features spacious, full-hookup RV sites with 30-amp and 50-amp electrical service, accommodating RVs of all sizes. Enjoy level concrete pads shaded by palm trees, providing a peaceful and private setting.
For relaxation after a day’s work, unwind in our solar-heated swimming pool or soothing gas-heated hot tub. Engage in pool tournaments, ping pong, and organized event dinners with fellow guests.
Our friendly, laid-back atmosphere is perfect for relaxation and socializing. The resort’s Gulf Coast location provides opportunities for beach activities, nature exploration, fishing, and boating.
Located conveniently in Aransas Pass, the resort offers easy access to major roads, essential services, job sites, Rockport Beach, Port Aransas, and the Texas State Aquarium.
Short and extended stays
Affordable rates for every kind of trip.
The Palms RV Park offers competitive rates for travelers staying for a night, a week, or several months.

Why guests choose The Palms
A top choice among Texas RV resorts.
Located in the heart of Aransas Pass, just minutes from Rockport and Port Aransas, The Palms RV Park offers an exceptional experience for RV enthusiasts. The park’s well-maintained facilities and thoughtful amenities set it apart from other RV parks in Texas.
01
Premium RV sites with full hookups.
The Palms RV Park is designed with your comfort and convenience in mind. Each spacious site includes:
Full Hookups: 30/50-amp electrical service, city water, and sewer connections.
Concrete Pads: Level, sturdy, and clean, providing a stable foundation for your RV.
Free Wi-Fi and Cable TV: Stay connected and entertained throughout your stay.
Room to Relax: Each site includes beautiful green spaces and palm trees for added privacy and comfort.
These premium sites accommodate RVs of all sizes, making The Palms RV Park a favorite among travelers looking for Texas RV resorts.
02
Resort-style amenities for relaxation and fun.
The Palms RV Park offers top-notch amenities that ensure a relaxing and enjoyable stay:
Solar-Heated Swimming Pool: Take a refreshing dip in the sparkling pool, perfect for cooling off on a warm Texas day.
Gas-Heated Hot Tub: Unwind in the soothing spa after a day of coastal exploration.
Modern Laundry and Bathhouse Facilities: Enjoy clean, well-maintained showers and convenient laundry services.
Pet-Friendly Dog Runs: Let your furry friends stretch their legs and play in the two designated dog runs.
Community Clubhouse: The clubhouse features a game room, pool tables, and space for events and social gatherings.
Organized Activities: Participate in park-hosted events like water aerobics, bingo, potlucks, karaoke nights, and holiday celebrations.
These amenities make The Palms RV Park more than just a place to park your RV; it’s a resort-style destination where relaxation meets community.
Explore Aransas Pass and beyond
Coastal adventure is always within reach.
One of the biggest advantages of staying at The Palms RV Park is its prime location in Aransas Pass, Texas. Whether you’re a beachgoer, a fisherman, or someone who enjoys exploring local culture, there’s something for everyone nearby.
01 · The shoreline
Port Aransas Beaches
Just a short drive away, Port Aransas offers pristine beaches perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and beachcombing. The ferry ride to Port Aransas is a scenic adventure in itself, making your beach day even more enjoyable.
02 · On the water
Fishing in Aransas Bay and Beyond
The Texas Coastal Bend is a paradise for anglers. Launch your boat, cast a line from the shore, or join a local fishing charter to catch redfish, speckled trout, and flounder in Aransas Bay and the Gulf of Mexico.
03 · Minutes away
Rockport-Fulton Attractions
Explore Rockport Beach—Texas’s first Blue Wave Beach—the restored Fulton Mansion State Historic Site, and the newly renovated Rockport Pier for fishing and coastal views.
04 · Corpus Christi
Texas State Aquarium
Learn about marine life, enjoy interactive exhibits, and see incredible Gulf Coast wildlife up close on a family-friendly outing.
05 · Protected coast
Padre Island National Seashore
Explore a preserved stretch of coastline offering stunning views, hiking trails, and opportunities to observe local wildlife.
Stay close to it all
Your Coastal Bend home base
Return to quiet palms, generous sites, and resort-style comfort at the end of every adventure.
Life at The Palms
Community and activities.
One of the standout features of The Palms RV Park is its strong sense of community. Guests frequently praise the park’s friendly atmosphere and engaging activities. Whether you’re staying for a short visit or an extended stay, you’ll find plenty of ways to connect with fellow travelers and make lasting memories.
These activities create a warm and welcoming environment, making it easy to feel at home during your stay at this premier RV park in Aransas Pass, Texas.
Extended stays are particularly popular among snowbirds and long-term travelers looking for comfort, affordability, and a convenient location. With amenities like laundry facilities, Wi-Fi, and organized events, long-term guests enjoy all the comforts of home.
Game Nights
Join your neighbors for pool, cards, or bingo in the clubhouse.
Potlucks and Social Events
Share a meal and enjoy good company during park-hosted dinners and holiday celebrations.
Fitness and Fun
Participate in water aerobics classes or enjoy a leisurely swim in the pool.
Seasonal Events
From karaoke nights to holiday parties, there’s always something happening at The Palms RV Park.

Long-Term RV Stays for Traveling Workers in Aransas Pass, Texas
Welcome to The Palms RV Park in Aransas Pass, Texas—a premier destination for traveling workers seeking long-term RV stays in Texas. Whether you're a healthcare professional, construction worker, or part of a mobile project team, our resort offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and community to make your extended stay both productive and enjoyable.
Spacious Full-Hookup RV Sites
Our resort features 136 full-hookup RV sites equipped with 30/50 AMP electrical service, water, and sewer connections. Each site includes a level concrete pad, providing a stable and comfortable foundation for your RV. With free high-speed Wi-Fi available throughout the resort, staying connected to work and family is effortless.
Resort-Style Amenities for Work-Life Balance
At The Palms RV Park, we understand the importance of balancing work responsibilities with relaxation. Our amenities are designed to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience:
Solar-heated swimming pool and gas-heated hot tub for year-round enjoyment.
Large clubhouse with game room, including pool tables and ping pong.
Organized event dinners, karaoke nights, water aerobics, and potluck dinners.
On-site laundry facilities and clean bathhouses with showers.
Two designated dog runs for your furry companions.
Library and picnic tables for leisure and relaxation.
Engaging Community and Activities
Our resort fosters a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, offering a variety of activities to help you unwind and connect with fellow guests:
Church services and community events to build connections.
Mobile RV repair services available on-site.
Excellent fishing opportunities nearby, including bay and deep-sea fishing.
Proximity to local attractions such as Rockport Beach, Port Aransas, and the Texas State Aquarium.
Prime Location in Aransas Pass, Texas
Located at 2135 W Wheeler Ave, Aransas Pass, TX 78336, our resort places you just minutes away from the beautiful beaches of the Gulf Coast. Enjoy activities like fishing, boating, and exploring nature preserves. The resort also provides easy access to major Texas cities such as Corpus Christi and Rockport, making it a convenient base for work and leisure.
Flexible Rates and Special Offers
We offer competitive rates to accommodate various lengths of stay:
Regular Sites: Daily $55, Weekly $300, Monthly $525 + electric
Premium Sites: Daily $65, Weekly $325, Monthly $575 + electric
Monthly reservations require a non-refundable reservation fee of $225 at the time of booking, which will be credited towards your last month's stay. Weekly reservations require a $100 reservation fee, and daily reservations require a $50 reservation fee, both non-refundable and credited towards your stay.
Guest Testimonials
Our guests consistently praise The Palms RV Park for its clean facilities, friendly staff, and vibrant community:
"We spent the winter of March 2023 at The Palms. The park is immaculate. Workers are always visible working in the park. They are friendly and willing to assist with any problem. The pool is small but clean. The hot tub is excellent. Walmart 15 minutes walk. An excellent park for snowbirds to spend the winter." — Rex McDermaid
"This is our second winter at The Palms and coming back next winter. Nice concrete level with plenty of space with beautiful palms and green space at each site. Nice clubhouse and game room. Pool tables, dances, dinners, happy hours, bingo, cards, crafts, hot tub and pool." — Kim Tapp
"We are so glad we found this place. We were looking to find a place to stay for a short period. The staff and people are very friendly. The grounds are very well kept up and nice pool and hot tub. The restroom and showers are very clean and nice laundry area. This is a very nice place to stay. If there is available sites, we will be back." — Debra Janosek
Explore Aransas Pass
Aransas Pass offers a variety of attractions to complement your stay:
Port Aransas beaches for sunbathing, swimming, and beachcombing.
Fishing opportunities in Aransas Bay and the Gulf of Mexico.
Rockport-Fulton attractions, including Rockport Beach and Fulton Mansion State Historic Site.
Texas State Aquarium in Corpus Christi for family-friendly outings.

Nestled in the heart of coastal Texas, The Palms RV Resort in Aransas Pass beckons El Campo, Texas residents to embark on an unforgettable journey of relaxation, adventure, and coastal charm. Here's why you should pack your bags, hit the road, and make The Palms your next destination.
1. Coastal Beauty at Your Doorstep: El Campo residents, accustomed to the charm of rural Texas, will be captivated by the coastal beauty that surrounds The Palms RV Resort. Wake up to the sound of gentle waves, stroll along pristine beaches, and bask in the warm Texas sun. It's a coastal paradise waiting to be explored.
2. Short Drive, Endless Memories: Located just a short drive away from El Campo, The Palms RV Resort offers the perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life. Leave behind the stress and immerse yourself in the tranquility of coastal living.
3. Unparalleled RV Comfort: Our resort boasts premium concrete motor coach and RV pads, ensuring that you'll enjoy the utmost comfort during your stay. Whether you're a seasoned RVer or a novice, you'll find everything you need for a relaxing getaway.

6. Culinary Delights: Take a short drive to Port Aransas by hopping on the Port Aransas ferry for a taste of fine dining. Explore the local seafood scene and savor the freshest catches from the Gulf of Mexico.
7. Relaxation and Rejuvenation: If you're looking for a serene escape, our resort has you covered. Unwind by our pool, soak in the hot tub, or simply lounge in the shade with a good book. It's your oasis of relaxation.
8. Proximity to Rockport: Just 8 miles away from Rockport, El Campo residents can explore this charming coastal town with ease. Visit art galleries, shop for unique souvenirs, and enjoy the coastal culture.
9. Wildlife Encounters: Coastal Texas is teeming with wildlife. Birdwatchers and nature enthusiasts will find themselves in paradise, with numerous opportunities to spot coastal birds and marine life.
10. Memories to Last a Lifetime: Whether you're planning a family vacation or a couples' getaway, The Palms RV Resort offers an unparalleled experience that will leave you with cherished memories for years to come.
El Campo residents, it's time to embrace the coastal lifestyle and experience the magic of The Palms RV Resort. The allure of coastal Texas, combined with the comfort and convenience of our resort, promises a vacation like no other. So, mark your calendar, pack your bags, and embark on a journey to coastal paradise. We can't wait to welcome you and make your stay with us truly memorable. Hope to see you soon!

The Two RV Park Welcomes You
BOOK NOW
Affordable Hide-Away is Just 5 Minutes from King Fisher Beach
Vacation destination for fishers, hunters, Winter Texans, and digital nomads
Bring your boat! Long-term visitors and their pets are welcome here. Escape the traffic in Corpus Christi, Houston, Victoria, and DFW and head for the very last bit of dry land before Texas meets the tides. The Two RV Park is just steps from the warm, fish-filled waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Stunning sunrises and tangy salt air beckon you to relax in this family-friendly, picturesque setting. Affordable RV sites and tiny homes too!
Accommodations and Rates
All the Amenities You Want
Even better than the comforts of home
Meet other outdoorsy folks in the clubhouse, play billiards, keep your catch nice ‘n cold with ice from the onsite ice-house, and clean those redfish, flounder, and drum at our fish cleaning station. Watch cable TV and connect with the outside world – we have free WiFi.
View All Amenities
Area Attractions
Fishing, hunting, golf, and swimming
Cast your line – day or night – from the pier at King Fisher Beach, hunt for deer and waterfowl on Matagorda Island, and take your kayak out on the Port O’Connor Paddling Trail. Feel like playing golf? Oso Beach Golf Course in nearby Corpus Christi offers 18 holes with tree-lined fairways. Go swimming and bird-watching at many beaches along Matagorda Bay and the Gulf of Mexico. C’mon in – the water’s fine! Lots of great restaurants too!
Area Attractions
All About The Two RV Park
Good things come in small packages
The Two RV Park is easy to find. Just take TX 185 to the very end, and there we are. Ideally situated, Port O’Connor rarely has tornados or hurricanes. Our 204 days of sunshine mean you’ll have plenty of time to enjoy the great outdoors. And Winter Texans…you can leave your mittens behind, because it never snows here. With just 41 RV sites, 3 Adventure Acres bunk huts, 2 tiny homes, and many long-term guests, you’ll soon make friends in this small, neighborly, ultra-clean park.

Thompson Lake RV Resort and Manufactured Home Park

Thompson Lake RV Resort is a beautiful community that sits on 35 acres surrounding Thompson Lake, a 10-acre artesian fresh water lake. The Resort has 116 sites and is strategically on the outskirts of the small Texas town of Silsbee (pop. 6,851) and close to the larger town of Beaumont (pop. 112,556). The rents are low, the fishing is great, and living is easy.
We offer you all the advantages of small town living and city shopping and amenities. This private, quiet and secluded RV Resort accepts both long-term and short-term stays, perfect for those who come visit for a day or remain for a month.
Or, perhaps you are looking for a permanent place to settle down that is close to employment opportunities and is still quiet and away from city living.
Our residents like Thompson Lake RV Resort because it is clean and quiet, away from the main road and has space between the RV sites.
While we are close to services and amenities, we have a country feel, nestled next to the private lake. We welcome Winter Texans and look forward to seeing our faithful Snow Birds return. We also welcome people who are employed in the area and need long-term RV space.
Thompson Lake, a privately-owned lake, is fed by an artesian well, so it is fresh water. Artesian water is the confined natural underground reservoir that contains water under positive pressure. It is a kind of spring water that is sourced from underground aquifers. Artesian water is considered the finest water to be had and it naturally rises to the surface.
Call us now to reserve your spot !!
Reserve Now
The amenities at Thompson Lake Resort are all included in the price of the pad:
Clubhouse, ready with comfortable seating and a gourmet coffee bar
Open air event patio with picnic tables, great for socializing
Covered pavilion / dock
Canoes and Kayaks allowed on the Lake
Four restrooms, inside the clubhouse
Four showers, inside the clubhouse
Laundry room with washers and dryers
Catch and release fishing is available all around the privately-owned lake, available to our guests only
Pet friendly (some restrictions apply – call us)
Full hookups with 30 and 50 amp connections
All utilities are included in rent
Reserve Now
409-385-0231
There is really no reason to ever leave Thompson Lake RV Resort.
MAKE A RESERVATION
ABOUT SILSBEE, TEXAS
Silsbee is situated in the very southeast corner of Texas, 30 miles from Louisiana, 20 miles from Beaumont, Texas. The area is wooded and is actually called the Big Thicket area of Texas. This area is noted for its deep woods, great fishing, hunting and camping. What makes the Big Thicket a remarkable place is the unusually high diversity of plants concentrated in a relatively small area. Information on the Big Thicket can be seen at
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Thicket
Silsbee is a Texas town full of friendly people, with a few retail sites and restaurants. Even though the town is small, it provides full-service amenities: auto shops, local restaurants, Dollar Tree, Walmart, Brookshire Brothers, CVS, churches, and multiple RV sales/service locations, all within 20 minutes of Thompson Lake RV Resort.

Valley Gateway RV Park
Family Owned Since 1984...
Valley Gateway RV Park is located 16 miles north of Edinburg, Texas on Hwy.
281 , just one mile south of Linn-San Manuel, Texas. It is 46 acres of quiet, peaceful atmosphere with trees from
native oaks to palms, and orange trees as well. This is a country park with large lots and plenty of wide open space.
It is a short drive to town, yet miles away from the border troubles . Also, we are away
from the rampant Covid Virus in the RGV cities. We are proud to have over 12 DPS officers staying with us.
Family owned and operated
since 1984, it is owned by Donna and Jim Bob Feller. Jim Bob has been a professional rodeo clown for over forty years traveling
all over the country. He is aware of what travelers expect when they pull in off the road. You can expect a clean park with
friendly, courteous management.
There is plenty of room for quiet, leisurely walks. We just opened a new Nature Trail on
the back 23 acres of the park. We are constantly making improvements in the park to make your stay enjoyable. Also new
Wi- Fi system is accessable throughout the Park. ( Wi- Fi is a free amenity and Park will not be resposible for
Carrier service/ Interruptions )
As you begin looking for a place to spend the winter, think
about the Rio Grande Valley and Valley Gateway Rv Park. We welcome our new guests and look forward to catching up with
our old friends. So come to see us and stay a day or a lifetime...
Call today to reserve your spot.

Home
Office Hours

Directions

Things To Do
Welcome to our little slice of Texas!
Since 1985, Yerby’s RV Park has been family owned and operated, dishing out friendly Texas style hospitality and great service. Come and stay awhile! We’d love for you to visit!
Dumas, Texas is a small town located in the Texas panhandle. Because it’s half way on the route between Denver, CO and Dallas, TX, several travelers stop in Dumas to eat, refuel, and stretch their legs.
We are conveniently located in town next to McDade Park, a beautiful city park. You can easily get a bite to eat, grab a few groceries, or pick up a few things at Walmart Supercenter with ease from Yerby’s RV Park.
FREE Wifi Available!
Our RV spaces have cooling green grass and beautiful large trees scattered throughout the park. A great place to wind down after a long day.
We have a laundry facility with heavy duty commercial washers (6) and dryers (5). A modern, clean and comfortable atmosphere to get caught up on your laundry.
Just one block east of Yerby’s RV Park is the Dumas Aquatic Center; which is located in McDade Park. You’ll find loads of fun there with several water slides and great water features.
Also, McDade Park has a 1/2 mile walking/running track, three covered pavilions with BBQ grills, a volleyball court, and a ping pong table.
If you’re staying for a few days and want to get a serious workout or swim some laps, the YMCA is located two blocks east of us just beyond McDade Park.
Maybe you’re into golf? Pheasant Trails Golf Course can accommodate you and at a very inexpensive price.
There’s plenty of things to do to keep you busy for a few days if you choose.
Check out our Things To Do page for photos and phone numbers.
Bring any size RV to Yerby’s RV Park and enjoy!
Whether you need to stay a few years, a few months or just a few hours, we can accommodate you. We’re lookin’ forward to seeing ya’ll soon!

Lodging Options at Sipapu Ski & Summer Resort
Sipapu’s slopeside lodging units are full of history and rich with character. Many units have been a part of the property since Lloyd and Olive Bolander founded the resort in 1952. Very few of our units are exactly alike.
Sipapu offers a simple, minimal mountain experience with no-frills accommodations.
Our remote, rural location makes our internet, septic, and electricity delicate. It’s our goal to offer affordable cabins and rooms that provide you with the opportunity to get outside into nature.
While all of our units, except for the Adobe House, have televisions, we do not offer satellite or cable. Therefore we invite our guests to bring or purchase a streaming device at our front desk.
The types of lodging we offer range from a basic motel room to a large lodge that can sleep up to 16.
Types of lodging include:
Full houses that sleep up to 16
Small, individual cabins
Connected suites, casitas, and duplexes
Lodge rooms that sleep up to six with paid access to a community kitchen
Hotel rooms that sleep up to four
learn more about all the units

Description of Accommodation Types:
Adobe House
The historic Adobe House offers a truly unique lodging experience. Located just across the highway from the base area, the restored Adobe House is the perfect choice for guests who desire a more secluded stay surrounded by the lush alpine valley. (Sleeps 3 to 14) BOOK NOW
The Big House
The Big House, hand-built by Bruce Bolander of the founding family of Sipapu, is available for rent. The house sleeps up to 16 people, is fully furnished, and has a fully equipped kitchen. It has 4 bedrooms, 2 1/2 baths. The views from the house are amazing, overlooking all of Sipapu. BOOK NOW
Casitas
The Casitas overlook our stocked trout fishing pond, our open-plan casitas are perfect for couples or small families. Sleeps 2 adults and 2 children. BOOK NOW
Suites
The suites feature 1 large bedroom with a king bed and two sets of twin sized bunk beds. With a full kitchen and one bathroom, the suites sleep up to a maximum of eight. BOOK NOW
Large Duplex
The large duplex features a fantastic rock fireplace and is just steps from the lifts and along the Rio Pueblo. Perfect for family gatherings or retreats. (Sleeps 2 to 8). BOOK NOW
Small Duplex
The small duplex is just steps from the lifts and along the Rio Pueblo. (Sleeps 4 to 6). BOOK NOW
Hotel Rooms
Hotel rooms are a typical hotel style with 1 room featuring 2 queen sized beds with a full bathroom. Each room contains a microwave and mini fridge and sleep a maximum of four. BOOK NOW
Lodge Rooms
Lodge rooms are a great, affordable option for families who want a little more space. Featuring open floor plans, the rooms have one queen-sized bed, 2 sets of twin bunk beds. Lodge rooms sleep a maximum of six people. Also available for booking is a large kitchen to accommodate groups. See photo below. BOOK NOW
Lodge Kitchen
The Lodge Kitchen is available for groups who are staying the lodge rooms. Perfect for groups, it’s the perfect kitchen space to help keep costs down for your family reunion, church youth group or retreat, and more. BOOK NOW
Mobile Home
The mobile home features four bedrooms with two bathrooms, plus a full kitchen and sleeps a maximum of 14 people. BOOK NOW
Riverside Cabins
The cabins feature an open floor plan with one queen-sized bed plus a loft with three twin beds, one bathroom, and a full kitchen. The Riverside Cabins sleep up to 5 comfortably. BOOK NOW
Campsites
Located right on the Rio Pueblo, our scenic campsites provide the perfect setting for exploring Sipapu and the surrounding area. Our campsites are limited to two tents per site, a maximum of six people, and one vehicle. Some trailers can dry camp in these spots. BOOK NOW
RV Sites
Our three RV sites are right on the Rio Pueblo, about 300 yards from the lodge. With full RV hookups, these spaces are not pull-through sites.

Sipapu Lodging Policies
Welcome to Sipapu!
We’re a no-frills, rural New Mexico property — things are simple around here! We appreciate your kindness and respect for the resort, the land, and the people that make this place so special. WELCOME!
Please take a minute to review our lodging policies.
We’re Here to Help
Thank you for choosing Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort! If you have any questions about your lodging reservation or Sipapu lodging policies, contact our helpful Sipapu reservation team at
[email protected] or call us at 575-587-2240 .
In case of after-hours emergency, please call 575- 799-9886
The Mountain Lodging Experience
Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort offers a no-frills, quintessential mountain lodge experience. This means our units do not have cable TV, hair dryers, shampoo, or laundry facilities, and we do not currently offer a swimming pool or hot tubs, although some guests enjoy the river.
Sipapu’s climate does not require air conditioners. We do not have telephones, although cell service is typically available throughout the resort property. Select accommodations may have kitchens, coffeemakers, microwaves, refrigerators, and TVs that only work with wifi (bring your streaming device – like a Roku or Fire Stick). For questions about Sipapu accommodations and amenities, contact our helpful Sipapu reservation team at 575-587-2240 .
Click here to view the Sipapu House Rules
Check-In and Check-Out
Sipapu’s check-in time is at 4:00 pm. When you arrive, please visit the main lodge to check in. Sipapu’s reservations desk is staffed daily. See hours of operation here . If you arrive after 6 pm in the summer, or 8 pm in the winter, your room key will be in an envelope with your name on it, and it will be affixed to the front door of our main lodge.
Check-out time at Sipapu is at 11:00 am. Please return your key at our reservations desk upon departure. A $10 fee will be charged if you do not return your key.
$50 deposit per day in the form of a credit card hold is required from all guests at time of check-in with a maximum of $500
Valid ID is required at every check-in, with no exceptions
When Your Credit Card is Charged
When Your Credit Card is Charged
A valid credit card is required to reserve a guest room, and Sipapu accepts VISA, MasterCard, Discover and American Express. Payment is due in full 15 days before arrival, including a $50 security deposit at check-in, with a maximum of $500 per stay. The deposit will be returned to the original card if there are no damages to the unit.
These holiday seasons require full payment 30 days prior to arrival and a $150 security deposit at check-in.
Presidents’ Weekend
Martin Luther King Weekend
Memorial Day Weekend
July (the entire month)
Labor Day Weekend
BMW Weekend
Thanksgiving Week
Christmas Week (week before and after Christmas)
New Year’s Week (the week before and the week after New Year’s)
Cancellation Policy
Cancellation Policy
Life happens, we get it. You may cancel your lodging reservation without penalty if you contact us:
At least 15 days before your scheduled arrival date, or
At least 30 days before your scheduled arrival date if your stay falls during one of the holiday seasons listed below.
If you cancel after these deadlines, you will not receive a refund. Instead, you will be charged for one night’s stay plus tax . This charge applies whether you cancel 1 day or 14 days before arrival (or up to 29 days before arrival during a holiday season) — the penalty is the same regardless of how close to the deadline you are.
Holiday seasons requiring 30 days’ notice:
Presidents’ Weekend
Martin Luther King Weekend
Memorial Day Weekend
July (the entire month)
Labor Day Weekend
BMW Weekend
Thanksgiving Week
Christmas Week (week before and after Christmas)
New Year’s Week (the week before and the week after New Year’s)
Group Lodging
Reserving a block of four (4) or more rooms is consider a group reservation at Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort.
Sipapu’s slope-side lodging accommodates groups of 200–400 guests, including lodge rooms, suites, cabins, and campsites.
Room Blocking
A one-time, non-refundable, non-transferrable $100 booking fee applies to block four or more rooms.
Reservation Requirements
Guests booking their own rooms must contact Sipapu at least 60 days before the event start and provide: group/event name, guest name, requested room type, check-in/check-out dates, and a valid credit card number.
Confirming & Releasing Blocked Rooms
Group organizers must confirm all blocked rooms at least 60 days before the event. Any rooms not confirmed by that 60-day mark are released and rebooked based on availability.
Group Cancellation Policy
No penalty applies for cancellations made at least 60 days before the event. If the 60-day deadline is missed, one night’s rate plus tax is charged per room booked.
Check-In / Check-Out Times
Check-in is 4:00 PM; all guests, including those in the campground, must check in upon arrival. Check-out is 11:00 AM, with keys returned to front desk staff. A $10 fee will be charged per key if not returned.
Tobacco & Alcohol
All lodging units and resort buildings are non-smoking; a $250 cleaning fee will be charged if smoking is suspected.
Alcohol purchased at the store may not be consumed in the meadows, under the tent, or in the parking lot without a special permit.
Alcohol purchased at the café may only be consumed in the dining area or downstairs patio.
For events and tent rentals, a bartender must be present and serve only alcohol provided by Sipapu.
Pets — Group Lodging
Per the Group Events Packet, pets are welcome in lodging rooms except the Riverside Cabins, the Hotel, the Duplex, the Big House, Lodge Rooms, and the Adobe House.
Damages — Group Facility Use
Sipapu may charge guests the cost of repairing damage to rooms, fixtures, furnishings, linens, and equipment — including removed electronics, towels, or paintings — at 120% of full replacement value. Excessive cleaning may incur an additional fee.
This 120% replacement charge applies specifically to group facility use. Section 9’s full (100%) replacement cost applies to standard individual guest stays.
Quiet Hours
10:00 PM to 7:00 AM.
Lodging Amenities
Rooms do not have TV remotes, air conditioning, cable TV, satellite, telephones, hair dryers, or shampoo; soap, linens, and towels are provided. Most units have smart TVs — guests may bring their own streaming device or purchase a Roku at the Front Desk. There is no hot tub or swimming pool on site.
Sipapu Pet Policy
Furry friends are family too at Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort! We are dog-friendly and welcome pets in many of our Sipapu lodging accommodations.
Pets are not permitted in the following units:
Hotel
Lodge
Big House
Adobe House
Duplex 14
Duplex 14B
Riverside Cabins
Pets are permitted in the suites, mobile home, and casitas.
First Pet: $75
Second pet: additional $25 (total $100 for two pets) — maximum of 2 pets per unit
Unregistered pet fee: if a guest fails to register a pet, an additional $75 penalty applies on top of the standard $75 pet fee (total $150)
Sipapu Lodging Policies for Smoking and Other Damages
All Sipapu lodging accommodations are non-smoking, and guests are responsible for any damages or extra cleaning costs due to smoking. Anyone who negligently or intentionally causes damage to our property will be liable for damages, including our resort’s loss of revenue resulting from the inability to rent rooms while the damage is being repaired.
In Case of Emergency
In case of after-hours lodging issues, please call 575-779-9886 or please call 911 in case of fire, flooding, or a medical emergency.
Resort Fee
A resort fee of 8% will apply to the guest’s entire invoice for their stay, effective November 1, 2026.
Minimum Stay Requirements
Sipapu requires a minimum stay on select units:
Hotel & Lodge: 1 night stay
Big House, Adobe House and Mobile Home: Minimum 3 night stay
Riverside Cabins, Casitas, Duplexes, and Suites: Minimum 2 night stay
What You Should Expect: Sipapu House Rules
The following fees apply per the Guest House Rules and Property Policy Agreement, charged to the guest’s card on file if issues are found at departure:
Excess trash left in unit: $30
Dishes left unwashed: $35
Bath towel misuse (mud, floors, boots, equipment, etc.): $45
Furniture moved, causing floor damage: $35
Damaged or missing heaters, fans, blankets, or kitchen supplies: $50
Items broken and not reported, or missing at checkout: full replacement cost of the set
No smoking: $250 fee

Sipapu Lodging Policies
Welcome to Sipapu!
We’re a no-frills, rural New Mexico property — things are simple around here! We appreciate your kindness and respect for the resort, the land, and the people that make this place so special. WELCOME!
Please take a minute to review our lodging policies.
We’re Here to Help
Thank you for choosing Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort! If you have any questions about your lodging reservation or Sipapu lodging policies, contact our helpful Sipapu reservation team at
[email protected] or call us at 575-587-2240 .
In case of after-hours emergency, please call 575- 799-9886
The Mountain Lodging Experience
Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort offers a no-frills, quintessential mountain lodge experience. This means our units do not have cable TV, hair dryers, shampoo, or laundry facilities, and we do not currently offer a swimming pool or hot tubs, although some guests enjoy the river.
Sipapu’s climate does not require air conditioners. We do not have telephones, although cell service is typically available throughout the resort property. Select accommodations may have kitchens, coffeemakers, microwaves, refrigerators, and TVs that only work with wifi (bring your streaming device – like a Roku or Fire Stick). For questions about Sipapu accommodations and amenities, contact our helpful Sipapu reservation team at 575-587-2240 .
Click here to view the Sipapu House Rules
Check-In and Check-Out
Sipapu’s check-in time is at 4:00 pm. When you arrive, please visit the main lodge to check in. Sipapu’s reservations desk is staffed daily. See hours of operation here . If you arrive after 6 pm in the summer, or 8 pm in the winter, your room key will be in an envelope with your name on it, and it will be affixed to the front door of our main lodge.
Check-out time at Sipapu is at 11:00 am. Please return your key at our reservations desk upon departure. A $10 fee will be charged if you do not return your key.
$50 deposit per day in the form of a credit card hold is required from all guests at time of check-in with a maximum of $500
Valid ID is required at every check-in, with no exceptions
When Your Credit Card is Charged
When Your Credit Card is Charged
A valid credit card is required to reserve a guest room, and Sipapu accepts VISA, MasterCard, Discover and American Express. Payment is due in full 15 days before arrival, including a $50 security deposit at check-in, with a maximum of $500 per stay. The deposit will be returned to the original card if there are no damages to the unit.
These holiday seasons require full payment 30 days prior to arrival and a $150 security deposit at check-in.
Presidents’ Weekend
Martin Luther King Weekend
Memorial Day Weekend
July (the entire month)
Labor Day Weekend
BMW Weekend
Thanksgiving Week
Christmas Week (week before and after Christmas)
New Year’s Week (the week before and the week after New Year’s)
Cancellation Policy
Cancellation Policy
Life happens, we get it. You may cancel your lodging reservation without penalty if you contact us:
At least 15 days before your scheduled arrival date, or
At least 30 days before your scheduled arrival date if your stay falls during one of the holiday seasons listed below.
If you cancel after these deadlines, you will not receive a refund. Instead, you will be charged for one night’s stay plus tax . This charge applies whether you cancel 1 day or 14 days before arrival (or up to 29 days before arrival during a holiday season) — the penalty is the same regardless of how close to the deadline you are.
Holiday seasons requiring 30 days’ notice:
Presidents’ Weekend
Martin Luther King Weekend
Memorial Day Weekend
July (the entire month)
Labor Day Weekend
BMW Weekend
Thanksgiving Week
Christmas Week (week before and after Christmas)
New Year’s Week (the week before and the week after New Year’s)
Group Lodging
Reserving a block of four (4) or more rooms is consider a group reservation at Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort.
Sipapu’s slope-side lodging accommodates groups of 200–400 guests, including lodge rooms, suites, cabins, and campsites.
Room Blocking
A one-time, non-refundable, non-transferrable $100 booking fee applies to block four or more rooms.
Reservation Requirements
Guests booking their own rooms must contact Sipapu at least 60 days before the event start and provide: group/event name, guest name, requested room type, check-in/check-out dates, and a valid credit card number.
Confirming & Releasing Blocked Rooms
Group organizers must confirm all blocked rooms at least 60 days before the event. Any rooms not confirmed by that 60-day mark are released and rebooked based on availability.
Group Cancellation Policy
No penalty applies for cancellations made at least 60 days before the event. If the 60-day deadline is missed, one night’s rate plus tax is charged per room booked.
Check-In / Check-Out Times
Check-in is 4:00 PM; all guests, including those in the campground, must check in upon arrival. Check-out is 11:00 AM, with keys returned to front desk staff. A $10 fee will be charged per key if not returned.
Tobacco & Alcohol
All lodging units and resort buildings are non-smoking; a $250 cleaning fee will be charged if smoking is suspected.
Alcohol purchased at the store may not be consumed in the meadows, under the tent, or in the parking lot without a special permit.
Alcohol purchased at the café may only be consumed in the dining area or downstairs patio.
For events and tent rentals, a bartender must be present and serve only alcohol provided by Sipapu.
Pets — Group Lodging
Per the Group Events Packet, pets are welcome in lodging rooms except the Riverside Cabins, the Hotel, the Duplex, the Big House, Lodge Rooms, and the Adobe House.
Damages — Group Facility Use
Sipapu may charge guests the cost of repairing damage to rooms, fixtures, furnishings, linens, and equipment — including removed electronics, towels, or paintings — at 120% of full replacement value. Excessive cleaning may incur an additional fee.
This 120% replacement charge applies specifically to group facility use. Section 9’s full (100%) replacement cost applies to standard individual guest stays.
Quiet Hours
10:00 PM to 7:00 AM.
Lodging Amenities
Rooms do not have TV remotes, air conditioning, cable TV, satellite, telephones, hair dryers, or shampoo; soap, linens, and towels are provided. Most units have smart TVs — guests may bring their own streaming device or purchase a Roku at the Front Desk. There is no hot tub or swimming pool on site.
Sipapu Pet Policy
Furry friends are family too at Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort! We are dog-friendly and welcome pets in many of our Sipapu lodging accommodations.
Pets are not permitted in the following units:
Hotel
Lodge
Big House
Adobe House
Duplex 14
Duplex 14B
Riverside Cabins
Pets are permitted in the suites, mobile home, and casitas.
First Pet: $75
Second pet: additional $25 (total $100 for two pets) — maximum of 2 pets per unit
Unregistered pet fee: if a guest fails to register a pet, an additional $75 penalty applies on top of the standard $75 pet fee (total $150)
Sipapu Lodging Policies for Smoking and Other Damages
All Sipapu lodging accommodations are non-smoking, and guests are responsible for any damages or extra cleaning costs due to smoking. Anyone who negligently or intentionally causes damage to our property will be liable for damages, including our resort’s loss of revenue resulting from the inability to rent rooms while the damage is being repaired.
In Case of Emergency
In case of after-hours lodging issues, please call 575-779-9886 or please call 911 in case of fire, flooding, or a medical emergency.
Resort Fee
A resort fee of 8% will apply to the guest’s entire invoice for their stay, effective November 1, 2026.
Minimum Stay Requirements
Sipapu requires a minimum stay on select units:
Hotel & Lodge: 1 night stay
Big House, Adobe House and Mobile Home: Minimum 3 night stay
Riverside Cabins, Casitas, Duplexes, and Suites: Minimum 2 night stay
What You Should Expect: Sipapu House Rules
The following fees apply per the Guest House Rules and Property Policy Agreement, charged to the guest’s card on file if issues are found at departure:
Excess trash left in unit: $30
Dishes left unwashed: $35
Bath towel misuse (mud, floors, boots, equipment, etc.): $45
Furniture moved, causing floor damage: $35
Damaged or missing heaters, fans, blankets, or kitchen supplies: $50
Items broken and not reported, or missing at checkout: full replacement cost of the set
No smoking: $250 fee

Doña | Player Services Assistant Manager
Doña has over 20 years with the Shoshone-Bannock Casino Hotel, beginning in April 2001. The fast pace and exciting atmosphere of the Shoshone-Bannock Casino Hotel enticed her to stay and gain experience in various internal departments. As a result, she knows the importance of our guests and their feedback. She’s experienced firsthand the importance of the line of communication from guests to our management. She enjoys working in customer service and hospitality. She will always help guests to give them the best experience she can. When she’s not at work, she prefers to do activities with her family, such as playing games and traveling.
KD | Host Supervisor
KD, has over 5 years of customer service experience under his belt. He began his career journey at the Shoshone-Bannock Tribal Fisheries and moved on to the Shoshone-Bannock Casino Hotel, gaining experience in multiple departments, eventually becoming a Casino Host. KD’s experience in various departments has helped to hone his adaptability and flexibility in meeting the dynamic demands of the casino environment. KD has worked his way up from Host to Host Supervisor. His goals are to strengthen his long‑lasting connections with players while assisting his team in enhancing overall guest experiences. He is consistently described by peers and teammates as hardworking and friendly. In his free time, he enjoys gaming online with friends, hunting and fishing with his family, detailing cars as a hobby, and working out at the gym to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
Patricia | Host
Patricia “Trish” has over 16 years’ worth of customer service experience; beginning when she was 15. She began working at the Shoshone-Bannock Casino Hotel in 2012, and has gained further hospitality experience in a variety of departments in and out of the Shoshone-Bannock Casino Hotel. She’s often described as “bubbly”, “over the top friendly”, and “eager to help.” She’s convinced the hospitality industry’s about making connections and creating the best memories for our guests, and is quick to bring smiles. She often enjoys going to concerts, theatre, movies, local restaurants, and traveling with friends and family.
Cassie | Host
Cassie has completed over 13 years in customer service. In August 2013, she worked in diverse departments such as front desk, Gaming machine floor worker, Bingo and Cage cashier. Cassie is now excited to add player development to her accomplishments. She delights in meeting new people and creating fantastic memories for each guest she interacts with. She has learned over the years that customer service is a top priority and truly enjoys each opportunity to build and be creative in the hospitality industry. Cassie is marvelously kind, clever, and wonderfully amicable. In her downtime, her main focus is spending time with loved ones, and traveling to exciting concerts.

As our campgrounds close for the season, we’re grateful for every moment shared—and we look forward to seeing our campers return next year.
Welcome to Camp Lutherwood
Disconnect in the middle of it all!
Come experience God’s creation, found nestled in the beautiful Dixie Forest of Southern Utah. Get away from the hustle and bustle of the world as you find your way down the gravel road that brings you to Camp Lutherwood. Our camp is a haven where you can truly unplug and immerse yourself in the beauty of nature. We are located right in middle of all Southern Utah has to offer, including Zion National Park, Bryce Canyon National Park, Brian Head, and Cedar City.
When you stay with us, the hardest choice you have to make is which direction to go!

What other travelers are saying about us:
“Camp Lutherwood is in a beautiful location! We enjoyed the quiet of nature and the friendly fellow campers. It was also so close to other beautiful places like Bryce Canyon. We would highly recommend making this place a part of your travels!”
“We have thoroughly enjoyed our stays at Camp Lutherwood. My parents had their 60th wedding anniversary celebration here with nearly the whole family in attendance. We had ample space to rest and play, cook, visit, and celebrate. We were frequently visited by the deer who ate out of our hand! I would highly recommend Camp Lutherwood for a restful vacation, or a family celebration, or a bit of both!”
“I have stayed at the camp twice. I had a great time filming and feeding the deer and I saw a jack rabbit for the first time. Biggest rabbit I ever saw. The cabins were great. The kitchen building was well stocked with all the tools for cooking and a dining area big enough for a large group. Very close to Bryce Canyon and Zion National Park. I have fond memories of times I was there.”
“Location, location location! How fun to spend some time in the midst of God's beautiful creation! Comfortable, relaxed cabins with all necessities nearby. Meals are enjoyed with family and friends in a fellowship hall. Access to state and national parks are simple and nearby. Affordable, safe, and comfortable for your family getaway. You will want to come back again and again! Make some beautiful memories!”
“Camp Lutherwood was the perfect spot for our large group’s camping trip! The location is incredibly convenient for exploring both Bryce Canyon and Zion National Park, as well as Duck Creek Village. The campgrounds are peaceful, not overrun with tourists, and the facilities are spotless. The bathrooms and showers are the nicest we’ve ever found at a campgroup. Our kids loved all the space to play, the mule deer that visited our site, and we all appreciated the large covered picnic area. We’ll definitely be back!”
“Our family had the pleasure of spending the better part of a week at Camp Lutherwood. With all of the peace and quiet, fresh air, and nature it would be hard not to. The hiking and sightseeing was fantastic. The Camp Hosts are very friendly and helpful. We were able to use the community area for all of us to gather as a family which was very nice. Can't wait to go back for another visit!”

About KM Resorts
30+ years of premium RV camping in Washington State and beyond
To us, an RV is an all-access pass to the natural wonders of the Northwest — and a perfect way to make lasting family memories across this breathtaking country.
That’s pretty much why our family got into to this business. As a family-owned entity, we believe in the importance of spending quality time with family and friends. We have been bringing people together around campfires and in clubhouses since 1987 when we acquired our first RV resort. We also know our customers like being able to talk directly with decision makers who value them as members and as people.
Since our start in 1987, we have grown to become the leader for private RV camping in Washington State. We're also Washington's clear leader in reciprocal camping, a type of membership camping that allows members discounted access to affiliated RV networks across the country.
Our resorts are here to make your RV adventures fun, affordable, and frequent.

1994 - Old American in Newport
